blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026.
  We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. We use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to rank observed differences between embedding distributions and employ a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to extract features from layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. Lastly, we employ GPT-6 Luna to come up with hypotheses about job roles' feature patterns, and GPT-6.1 Terra to investigate whether those patterns exist in held-out job descriptions from unseen companies.
  Some example findings include Data Scientist advertisements placing more emphasis on machine learning model development, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on applying developed models in real-world settings. We also observe differences in the applications described by Data Analyst and Business Analyst advertisements across selected months, although our dataset's scale and uneven coverage limit their interpretation. Overall, we present a realistic application of SAEs and PERC to unstructured textual data and examine how automated insight extraction could support manual analysis of job descriptions.
blocks.zh:
单是职称和职务说明,对技术作用在不断变化的就业市场中有何不同提供了有限的见解。 为了评估这些角色在工作和行业应用上有何不同,我们根据深层学习和变压器表现设计并比较两种方法,使用2025年12月至2026年10月期间从美国LinkedIn收集的36 081个早期职业岗位。
我们首先采用PERC,简称为预处理(P),嵌入(E),维度降低(R)和集群(C). 我们利用GPT-6 Luna将职务说明段落归类为团队背景、角色任务和资格。 然后我们创建这些章节的组合,并检查嵌入和集群分解段落是否产生关于不同工作角色的有意义的语义集群. 我们使用"最大平均差分"(MMD)来对嵌入分布之间的已观测到的差异进行分级,并使用被预先训练的稀有自编码器(SAE)从Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的第19层代表物中提取出特征. 最后,我们利用GPT-6 Luna来提出有关工作角色特征模式的假设,以及GPT-6.1 Terra来调查这些模式是否存在于来自未见公司的职务说明中。
例如,数据科学家的广告更加强调机器学习模型的开发,数据分析员的广告强调报告业务业绩,机器学习工程师的广告强调在现实环境中应用已开发模型。 我们还观察到数据分析员和商业分析员广告所描述的应用程序在选定的几个月中存在差异,尽管我们数据集的规模和不均衡的覆盖范围限制了其解释。 总而言之,我们提出一个现实的应用,即SAEs和PERC对非结构化的文本数据进行应用,并审查自动化的洞察力提取如何能够支持对职务说明的人工分析。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: What do job titles and job descriptions tell us at first glance? Do they inform us about the distinct nature of a role or what we should expect from similar roles across the job market?
blocks.zh: 职称和职务说明乍一看会告诉我们什么? 它们是否告诉我们一个角色的独特性质,或者我们应该从整个就业市场的类似角色中期待什么?

blocks.en: With job postings arriving daily, if not hourly, this pool of messy and unstructured text makes it difficult to assess differences in the work being advertised. Amid the changing job market, a natural question for early-career job seekers is: what roles are changing with the advent of AI, and what tools can help us examine the work, the teams and the qualifications that employers describe?
blocks.zh: 由于工作职位每天,甚至每小时都到来,这种杂乱无章的文本使得难以评估所公布工作的差异。 在不断变化的就业市场中,早期求职者的一个自然问题是:随着AI的出现,哪些角色正在发生变化,哪些工具可以帮助我们审查雇主描述的工作、团队和资格?

blocks.en: Intuitively, we could track how often a skill is mentioned or how many positions are posted. However, descriptions can share keywords and still refer to different work. Python might be used to develop “machine learning models”, maintain an application or automate a business report. Skill counts alone do not show how the tools are used.
blocks.zh: 直觉上,我们可以追踪提到技能的频率或公布的职位数目。 然而,描述可以共享关键词,仍指不同作品. Python可用于开发“机器学习模型”,维护应用程序或实现商业报告自动化。 技能本身不能显示工具是如何使用的。

blocks.en: To examine this context, we first apply PERC , short for Preprocessing, Embedding, Reduction and Clustering . This framework converts descriptions into vectors and groups postings with similar meaning. We then use Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to identify large distributional differences, and GPT-6.1 Terra reads the full descriptions from the selected clusters to explain what differs in their work, team context and qualifications.
blocks.zh: 为了审查这一背景,我们首先采用PERC,简称为预处理、嵌入、减少和集群。 这个框架将描述转换成矢量,并分组发布类似的含义. 然后我们使用最大平均值(MMD)来识别巨大的分布差异,GPT-6.1 Terra从选定的集群中读取了完整的描述,以解释他们的工作,团队背景和资格的不同.

blocks.en: Meanwhile, we apply a pretrained 537-million-parameter sparse autoencoder (SAE) from Goodfire to the layer-19 representations of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct. The SAE extracts features that can activate together within a description. GPT-6 Luna uses those features to propose differences between occupations or months, and GPT-6.1 Terra checks whether the proposed characteristics also appear in postings from held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 同时,我们使用一个预先训练的5.37亿参数的稀有自动编码器(SAE),从古德火到Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的19层代表. SAE提取了可以在描述中一起激活的特性. GPT-6 Luna利用这些特征提出职业或月份之间的差异,GPT-6.1 Terra检查拟议特征是否也出现在被搁置公司的张贴中。

blocks.en: Together, these methods let us ask what grouping descriptions and examining their features each reveal, how their findings compare with GPT-6 Luna reading the text without either representation, and whether they identify occupational or monthly differences. We examine Data Science (DS), Data Analytics (DA), Software Engineering (SWE), Machine Learning Engineering (MLE) and Business Analysis (BA) using early-career job postings collected through our hourly scraper from December 2025 to October 2026.
blocks.zh: 这些方法加在一起,让我们问一下,这些方法的分类说明和检查其特征都揭示了哪些内容,它们的调查结果如何与GPT-6 Luna阅读文本时没有说明,以及它们是否识别职业差异或月差异。 我们利用2025年12月至2026年10月通过我们小时刮纸机收集的早期职业岗位,审查数据科学、数据分析、软件工程、机器学习工程和商业分析。

blocks.en: 2 Literature Review
blocks.zh: 2 文学评论

blocks.en: The point of this research is to examine whether methods that group job descriptions or identify features within them can help us understand the work underneath a job title. Namely, if two companies are both hiring a data scientist, we want to examine whether those positions involve similar responsibilities, serve different applications, or change in what they describe from month to month.
blocks.zh: 这项研究的重点是审查小组职务说明或其中特征的方法是否能够帮助我们了解职称下的工作。 也就是说,如果两个公司同时雇用一名数据科学家,我们想审查这些职位是否涉及类似的职责,服务于不同的应用,或者改变他们所描述的每月。

blocks.en: Prior studies use NLP tools to extract skills, cluster job postings and describe the roles they find. We draw from these studies with particular attention to the text each method examines and the insights it can produce.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究使用NLP工具来提取技能,集群职位发布并描述他们找到的角色. 我们从这些研究中汲取经验教训,特别注意每种方法所审查的案文及其能产生的见解。

blocks.en: 2.1 Precedents in Textual Analytics and Topic Modeling
blocks.zh: 2.1 文字分析和专题模型的先例

blocks.en: Lukauskas et al. [1] present a methodology closely related to PERC, examining more than 500,000 Lithuanian job postings to construct groups of similar jobs. They extract requirements, represent the text with sentence embeddings and compare reduction and clustering methods. GPT-4 then describes these groups from their keywords and human experts assess the descriptions.
blocks.zh: 卢卡斯卡斯等人. [1] 提出了与PERC密切相关的方法,审查了超过50万个立陶宛工作岗位,以构建类似工作的组别. 它们提取要求,用嵌入的句子代表文本,并比较减少和分组方法. GPT-4然后从其关键词来描述这些团体,人类专家评估这些描述.

blocks.en: We adopt a similar sequence and examine seven segmentation text inputs formed from Team context, Role task and Qualifications. Separating these passages lets us distinguish what the employer requests from what the applicant would do. For example, an ad can request a statistics degree without asking the applicant to build statistical models. For the final cluster comparisons, we give GPT-6.1 Terra every full job description in the selected groups, allowing it to inspect applications and exceptions beyond a list of keywords.
blocks.zh: 我们采用类似的顺序,并审查从小组背景、作用任务和资格中形成的七条分区文字投入。 将这些段落分开,让我们能区分雇主的要求和申请人会做什么。 例如,广告可以要求统计学位,而不要求申请人建立统计模型。 对于最后的集群比较,我们给出了GPT-6.1 Terra在所选集群中每一个完整的职务描述,使其能够检查关键词列表以外的应用程序和例外.

blocks.en: Other studies examine several kinds of work beneath the data-science title. Michalczyk et al. [2] combine topic modeling, clustering and expert assessment of 25,104 postings to identify six roles. Gunklach et al. [3] use BERTopic and K-medoids on 16,348 unique postings, representing each through its topic distribution and identifying nine roles through manual assessment.
blocks.zh: 其他研究考察了数据科学标题之下的几种作品. 米哈尔奇克等人. [2] 将25,104个帖子的专题建模、分组和专家评估结合起来,以确定六个角色。 贡克拉赫等人. [3] 在16,348个独有的帖子上使用BERTopic和K-medoids,每个帖子通过其专题分布来代表,并通过人工评估确定九个角色.

blocks.en: 2.2 Precedents in Skill Theme Extraction
blocks.zh: 2.2 技能主题提取的先例

blocks.en: We also examine how embeddings and topic models help compare requested skills, given that Qualifications is one of our segmentation text inputs. Skill Scanner [4] applies Sentence-BERT, UMAP, DBSCAN and K-means to compare skills across job postings, CVs and a data-science curriculum. Gurcan et al. [5] use a MiniLM-based BERTopic model to examine skill themes in 3,156 big-data postings across Analyst, Engineer, Developer and Architect categories. Their categories come from job-title terms, so the BERTopic analysis examines differences within already-defined occupations. Our occupation labels serve a similar purpose.
blocks.zh: 我们还审查嵌入和专题模型如何有助于比较所要求的技能,因为资格是我们分类文本投入之一。 技能扫描仪 [4] 应用Prime-BERT,UMAP,DBSCAN和K-means来比较各职位职位、简历和数据科学课程的技能。 古尔坎等人著. [5] 使用基于MiniLM的BERTOPIC模型,在分析师,工程师,开发者和建筑师类别的3,156个大数据发布中检查技能主题. 他们的类别来自职称术语,所以BERTOPIC分析研究了已经定义的职业中的差异. 我们的占领标签具有类似的目的。

blocks.en: On top of identifying skills, researchers examine how to connect different expressions to a common category. SkiLLens [6] uses embeddings and language models to map candidate skills to ESCO, the European classification of skills and occupations, with human review supporting multilingual classification. TaxonomyBuilder [7] examines how filtering postings affects AI-skill and task taxonomies produced through clustering and language-model labeling. The reported improvement in domain coverage illustrates how filtering can change the resulting taxonomy. In our study, we examine which text to include within each advertisement by comparing Team context, Role task and Qualifications separately and in combination.
blocks.zh: 除了识别技能外,研究人员还研究如何将不同的表达方式与一个共同的类别联系起来。 SkiLLens [6]使用嵌入和语言模型将候选技能映射到ESCO,即欧洲技能和职业分类,人类审查支持多语种分类. 分类构造器 [7] 研究过滤发布如何影响通过集群和语言模式标签制作的AI-skill和任务分类. 所报告的域覆盖范围的改善说明过滤如何改变由此产生的分类。 在我们的研究中,我们通过对团队背景、角色任务和资格进行单独和综合的比较,审查将哪些案文列入每一广告。

blocks.en: Sentence-BERT [12] provides a foundation for comparing sentences with similar meaning even when their words differ. Colombo et al.’s VEUCTOR [8] examines training, selecting and aligning representations using 4.5 million postings across 28 languages, finding that embedding model choices affect occupational skill groupings. We examine that issue through joint configuration searches over embedding, reduction and clustering methods.
blocks.zh: 句子-BERT [12] 提供了将句子与类似含义进行比较的基础,即使其词句不同. 科伦坡等人的VEUCTOR [8] 利用28种语言的450万个职位来审查培训、选择和调整陈述,发现嵌入模式选择会影响职业技能的类别。 我们通过对嵌入、减少和分组方法进行联合配置搜索来审查这一问题。

blocks.en: 2.3 Precedents in Occupation and Monthly Comparisons
blocks.zh: 2.3 职业先例和每月比较

blocks.en: Kauttonen et al. [9] compare 107,335 ICT job postings with 18,254 thesis abstracts over twelve years using subject indexing, TF-IDF, truncated SVD and K-means, followed by UMAP visualization. Their study distinguishes the representation used for grouping from the projection used to display it. We make the same distinction: two-dimensional maps show part of the vector variation, and MMD uses the original embeddings.
blocks.zh: Kauttonen等人著. [9] 比较107,335个信通技术职位,12年中使用主题索引的论文摘要18,254个,TF-IDF,短音SVD和K-means,然后UMAP可视化. 他们的研究区分了用于分组的表示和用于显示的预测. 我们做出同样的区分:二维地图显示部分矢量变异,MMD使用原始嵌入.

blocks.en: Labussière and Bol [10] use topic models of extracted skills and MMD to examine whether occupation labels describe the skill content of individual jobs. Their findings include differences within occupations and similarities across occupation boundaries. This provides a direct precedent for applying MMD to labor-market data.
blocks.zh: Labussière和Bol [10]使用抽取技能的话题模型和MMD来检查职业标签是否描述个人工作的技能内容. 他们的调查结果包括职业内部的差异和跨越职业界限的相似性。 这为将小额供资和微型企业发展应用于劳动力市场数据提供了直接先例。

blocks.en: We adopt that strategy to compare collections of job vectors, such as DS task descriptions from two posting months. Gretton et al. [11] provide the kernel two-sample framework underlying MMD. We use the score to select large observed differences for inspection, then ask GPT-6.1 Terra to explain them from the source descriptions.
blocks.zh: 我们采取这一战略是为了比较工作载体的收集情况,例如从两个张贴月的DS任务说明。 Gretton等人著. [11]提供内核双样本框架基础MMD. 我们用分数来选择观测到的巨大差异进行检查,然后请GPT-6.1 Terra从源描述中解释.

blocks.en: 2.4 Precedents in Adopting SAEs for Data Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.4 采用SAE进行数据分析的先例

blocks.en: Cho et al. [13] already apply SAEs to labor-market text, examining the internal representations supporting contextual skill substitution in a masked language model. They examine whether a skill can replace another in a particular work context, whereas we examine which characteristics distinguish occupations or months.
blocks.zh: Cho等人 (英语). [13] 已经将SAEs适用于劳动力市场文本,审查了支持以蒙面语言模式替代背景技能的内部表述。 他们审查某一技能能否在特定工作环境中取代另一技能,而我们则审查哪些特征能区分职业或月份。

blocks.en: To examine those differences, we adopt the dataset-comparison procedure introduced by Jiang et al. [14] . The authors rank features by activation-frequency differences, interpret them using examples and combine related features into hypotheses about properties that differ between datasets. A language-model judge then checks those hypotheses against documents.
blocks.zh: 为了审查这些差异,我们采用了Jiang等人采用的数据集比较程序。 [14]. 作者通过激活-频率差异来排列特征,使用实例来解释,并将相关特征合并为关于不同数据集的属性的假设. 一个语言模型法官然后对照文件检查这些假设。

blocks.en: For example, a feature might activate on passages about developing “machine learning models”. A hypothesis defines which activities count as “developing machine learning models” and proposes that they occur more often in one of the two groups of advertisements. GPT-6.1 Terra checks that definition in job descriptions from companies excluded from hypothesis generation, returning present, absent or unclear with supporting quotes. The percentage of advertisements in which Terra identifies the characteristic is therefore distinct from the percentage in which the SAE feature activates.
blocks.zh: 例如,关于开发“机器学习模式”的段落可能会激活一个功能。 一种假说将哪些活动算作“开发机器学习模型”,并提议在两类广告中更经常地出现。 GPT-6.1 Terra检查被排除在假设生成之外的公司在职务说明中的定义,返回现值、缺位或与佐证引文不明确。 因此,Terra公司确定特征的广告百分比不同于SAE公司特征激活的百分比。

blocks.en: Jiang et al. use Llama-3.3-70B and a Goodfire SAE at layer 50 in their main experiments. We use Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with its layer-19 Goodfire SAE following the toolkit’s configuration for the 8B-parameter Llama model. We also examine the full dataset with Gemma 2 2B and Gemma Scope [15] . This separate analysis reveals sensitivity to description length and formatting, motivating those checks in the comparison.
blocks.zh: Jiang等人在其主要实验中使用Llama-3.3-70B和50层的Goodfire SAE. 我们使用Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, 并使用其第19层Goodfire SAE, 我们还与Gemma 2 2B和Gemma Space [15] 检查了完整的数据集. 这一单独分析揭示了描述长度和格式化的敏感性,推动了这些检查的比较。

blocks.en: 2.5 The Contribution of This Research
blocks.zh: 2.5 本研究的贡献

blocks.en: With these precedents, we combine segmentation, PERC, MMD ranking and language-model inspection into a reproducible analysis of early-career technical jobs. We compare that workflow with pretrained SAE analysis and GPT-6 Luna on the same selected descriptions, then examine what the resulting findings explain about DS, DA, MLE, BA and SWE work.
blocks.zh: 有了这些先例,我们将分级制,PERC,MMD排名和语言模型检查结合起来,对早期职业技术工作进行可复制的分析. 我们将该工作流程与经过预先培训的SAE分析以及GPT-6 Luna在相同的选定描述上进行比较,然后审查由此产生的结论对DS、DA、MLE、BA和SWE工作有何解释。

blocks.en: We compare which distinctions the methods share and which additional characteristics they propose, then examine how formatting of the original descriptions, repeated recruitment and small monthly samples affect the findings. We also connect the representations by examining SAE feature activations within PERC clusters selected for comparison using MMD.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了这些方法共有的哪些区别以及它们提出的哪些其他特点,然后审查原始说明的格式、重复征聘和每月小样本如何影响调查结果。 我们还通过审查在选用MMD进行比较的PERC集群中SAE特性激活来连接表述.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: To examine what the job postings tell us about the nature of the work, we first apply PERC to group descriptions with similar meaning and then apply Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) to identify which distributions of job description vectors differ the most. After this, we employ GPT-6.1 Terra to read every full job description from the selected cluster groups and explain differences in Team context, Role task and Qualifications.
blocks.zh: 为了检查工作公告告诉我们的工作性质,我们首先将PERC应用于具有类似含义的组别描述,然后应用最大平均差异(MMD)来确定工作描述矢量的哪些分布差异最大. 在此之后,我们利用GPT-6.1 Terra阅读所选分组的每一个完整的职务说明,并解释小组背景、角色任务和资格方面的差异。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, we apply a pretrained sparse autoencoder from Goodfire with approximately 537 million parameters and a dictionary of 65,536 features to examine the activations at layer 19 of Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct as it reads each job-ad section. We then use GPT-6 Luna to turn those features into proposed hypotheses about differences between occupations or months. Finally, GPT-6.1 Terra checks whether the same characteristics also appear in job descriptions from held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 同时,我们使用了来自Goodfire的经过预先训练的稀疏自动编码器,其中包含大约5.37亿个参数,以及65 536个功能的字典,用于检查Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct第19层的激活情况,因为它读取了每个待职部分。 然后我们用GPT-6 Luna 把这些特性变成关于职业或月数之间差异的假设。 最后,GPT-6.1 Terra检查被搁置公司的工作说明中是否也出现同样的特征。

blocks.en: Figure 1: A PERC workflow diagram that follows job advertisements from preparation to cluster comparison and language-model interpretation. The upper row demonstrates our design for how a typical job receives preprocessing, section segmentation, embedding, dimensionality reduction and clustering. The lower row compares two cluster distributions and ranks their MMD scores before GPT-6.1 Terra reads the selected advertisements. The narrative example shown in the figure contrasts December 2025 descriptions of more “supervised work” with August 2026 descriptions of “greater operational responsibility” generated via an LLM verifier at the end.
blocks.zh: 图1:PERC工作流程图,遵循从编制到集群比较和语言模型解释的招聘广告. 上行展示了我们如何设计一个典型的工作,即如何接受预处理、分区分割、嵌入、维度降低和集群。 下行比较了两个集群的发行量,并在GPT-6.1Terra读取所选广告之前排名他们的MMD分数. 图中显示的叙述性例子与2025年12月关于更多“监督工作”的说明与2026年8月关于通过LLM核查员在结尾产生的“更大的业务责任”的说明形成对比。

blocks.en: 3.1 Preprocessing (P): Preparing and Separating Job Descriptions
blocks.zh: 3.1 预处理(P):准备和分离任务说明

blocks.en: We collect 41,040 records through our hourly scraper and retain 36,081 job postings after checking dates and text, removing copies posted on the same date, identifying company names and selecting early-career positions. By early career, we refer to internships, co-ops, junior and new-graduate positions, as well as descriptions requesting zero to two years of experience. The retained sample contains 35,511 internships and only 570 other early-career positions. This implies that our findings would primarily reflect the narratives of internship advertisements rather than those of full-time early-career roles. (Appendix A provides more information about the filtering rules and the number of postings retained at each step.)
blocks.zh: 我们通过小时刮纸机收集了41,040份记录,并在核对日期和文本、删除同日张贴的拷贝、确定公司名称和选择早期职位后保留了36,081份工作。 到了早期的职业生涯,我们指的是实习,合作,初级和新生职位,以及要求0到2年经验的描述. 保留样本包括35 511个实习和570个其他早期职业职位。 这意味着我们的调查结果将主要反映实习广告的叙述,而不是全职的早期职业角色。 (附录A提供更多信息,说明过滤规则和每一步骤保留张贴的次数。 )

blocks.en: Posting dates span 29 observed months from August 2023 to October 2026. Our scraper began collecting in December 2025 and could retrieve older postings that remained on the board, so we group jobs by posting date and separate older collected postings from fresh observations in the method comparison.
blocks.zh: 2023年8月至2026年10月的观测期为29个月。 我们的刮刮机于2025年12月开始收集,可以回收留在板上的旧职位,因此我们通过张贴日期来分组工作,并在方法比较中将收集的旧职位与新的观察分开。

blocks.en: After this, we divide each job description into short passages and use GPT-6 Luna to classify what each passage describes. We retain the passages labeled as Team context, Role task or Qualifications and group them into the following sections without changing their original wording: • Team context: the team that the applicant would join and the problem it addresses, such as turning scene understanding into autonomous-vehicle behavior. • Role task: what the applicant would do within that team, such as improving data pipelines used to train “machine learning models” for trajectory prediction. • Qualifications: the background that the employer requests, such as enrollment in a master’s program in computer science, machine learning or robotics. To examine which parts provide useful insights, we compare seven segmentation text inputs : the three individual sections, Team context + Role task, Team context + Qualifications, Role task + Qualifications, and all three joined together. We retain all job types during preprocessing, then use occupation names in titles or role introductions to identify DS, DA, MLE, BA and SWE for occupation comparisons.
blocks.zh: 之后,我们将每个职务描述分为短段,并使用GPT-6 Luna来分类每个段落描述的内容. 我们保留了标注为团队背景,角色任务或资格的段落,将其分组为以下各节,而不改变其原始措辞: 团队背景:申请人将加入的团队及其所处理的问题,例如将场景理解转化为自主车辆行为. • 支助 作用任务:申请者在该团队内将做什么,例如改进用于培训用于轨迹预测的“机器学习模型”的数据管道。 • 资格:雇主要求的背景,如计算机科学硕士课程的入学、机器学习或机器人。 为了审查哪些部分提供了有用的见解,我们比较了7个分区的文本投入:3个单独部分,团队背景+角色任务,团队背景+资格,角色任务+资格,所有三个部分合并在一起. 在预处理期间,我们保留所有的工作类型,然后在标题或角色介绍中使用职业名称来识别DS、DA、MLE、BA和SWE进行职业比较。

blocks.en: Team context: the team that the applicant would join and the problem it addresses, such as turning scene understanding into autonomous-vehicle behavior.
blocks.zh: 团队背景:申请人将加入的团队及其所处理的问题,如将场景理解转化为自主车辆行为.

blocks.en: Role task: what the applicant would do within that team, such as improving data pipelines used to train “machine learning models” for trajectory prediction.
blocks.zh: 作用任务:申请者在该团队内将做什么,例如改进用于培训用于轨迹预测的“机器学习模型”的数据管道。

blocks.en: Qualifications: the background that the employer requests, such as enrollment in a master’s program in computer science, machine learning or robotics.
blocks.zh: 资格:雇主要求的背景,如计算机科学硕士课程的入学、机器学习或机器人。

blocks.en: Figure 2: A line chart and a horizontal bar chart that show how many job advertisements remain after each preprocessing step and how many advertisements each step removes, respectively. When we apply the preprocessing steps, the number of job advertisements falls from 41,040 to 36,081. The largest decrease occurs when we select early-career positions and filter out 4,238 advertisements, compared with 319 advertisements removed for empty descriptions and 276 advertisements removed through same-day deduplication.
blocks.zh: 图2:一张线条图和一张横向条形图,显示每个预处理步骤之后还有多少工作广告,以及每个步骤移除多少广告。 当我们应用预处理步骤时,招聘广告的数量从41,040个下降到36,081个. 减少幅度最大的是,我们选择了早期职位,过滤了4,238个广告,而删除了319个广告,以作空描述,删除了276个广告,通过同一天的调离。

blocks.en: 3.2 Embedding (E): Turning Job Descriptions into Vectors
blocks.zh: 3.2 嵌入(E):将任务描述转化为矢量

blocks.en: Once we have separated the descriptions, we join the passages belonging to each segmentation text input before embedding. Each posting therefore contributes one vector per available input, so four task passages become one Role task vector. We compare job vectors formed from the same input.
blocks.zh: 一旦我们把描述分开,我们就在嵌入之前加入属于每个分区文字输入的段落. 因此,每次张贴都提供每个可用输入的一个矢量,因此四个任务段落成为一个角色任务矢量. 我们比较来自相同输入的工作矢量。

blocks.en: We examine MiniLM, MPNet, BGE, E5, EmbeddingGemma 2 and text-embedding-3-small. Text that exceeds an embedding model’s input limit is embedded in chunks and combined into one vector. (Appendix A.4 provides more information about the embedding model settings and how we combine chunk embeddings into one vector.)
blocks.zh: 我们检查了迷你LM,MPNet,BGE,E5,EmbeddingGemma 2和文本嵌入3小。 超过嵌入模型输入限制的文字被嵌入块中,并合并成一个向量. (附录A.4提供了有关嵌入模型设置的更多信息,以及我们如何将块嵌入组合成一个向量. )

blocks.en: Figure 3: A cosine-similarity matrix comparing five Role task advertisements embedded with text-embedding-3-small. The adjacent excerpts show the tasks described in those advertisements. Among these five Role task examples, Data Analyst and Machine Learning Engineer have the highest cosine similarity at 0.65 and Business Analyst and Software Engineer have the lowest at 0.38. The excerpts contrast data pipelines and application development with marketing analysis and reporting, showing how we can compare the work described beneath different occupation names.
blocks.zh: 图3:一个同位素-同位素矩阵,将嵌入文本-嵌入-3-小的5个角色任务广告进行比较. 相邻的摘录显示了这些广告中描述的任务. 在这5个角色任务实例中,数据分析师和机器学习工程师的余弦相似度最高,为0.65,业务分析师和软件工程师最低,为0.38. 这些节选将数据管道和应用开发与营销分析和报告作对比,表明我们如何比较不同职业名称下描述的工作。

blocks.en: 3.3 Reduction (R), Clustering (C) and Framework Config Grid Search
blocks.zh: 3.3 减少(R)、分组(C)和框架配置网格搜索

blocks.en: We randomly split company names into training (60%), validation (20%) and test (20%) sets. All postings from one company stay together, allowing us to examine whether a framework fitted to one set of employers also groups descriptions from held-out employers.
blocks.zh: 我们随机将公司名称分为培训(60%)、鉴定(20%)和测试(20%)等几套。 一家公司的所有职位都放在一起,使我们能够审查一个适合一组雇主的框架是否也从被搁置的雇主那里归纳出来。

blocks.en: For each segmentation text input, we compare PCA and UMAP alongside the original vectors and then compare K-means, Gaussian mixtures, hierarchical agglomerative clustering, spectral clustering and HDBSCAN. We first require an Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) of at least 0.60 across runs and assignment of at least 60% of validation descriptions to clusters. Every cluster must include at least ten training companies, five validation companies and ten validation advertisements, with no training company contributing more than 20% of its descriptions. Among configurations meeting these criteria, we select the highest positive TF-IDF cosine silhouette, which measures how distinctly the clusters use words. The selected framework must use PCA or UMAP. We also report silhouette on the original embedding vectors. (Appendix A.5 provides more information about the criteria for selecting the right PERC framework configuration and how we calculate each measurement.)
blocks.zh: 对于每个分块文字输入,我们与原始矢量一起比较五氯苯甲醚和UMAP,然后比较K-分子、高斯混合物、分层分层群、光谱群和HDBSCAN。 我们首先要求经过调整的兰德指数(ARI)至少为0.60, 并且至少为集群分配60%的验证说明。 每个集群必须至少包括10个培训公司,5个验证公司和10个验证广告,没有任何培训公司贡献其描述的20%以上. 在满足这些标准的配置中,我们选择了最高的正向 TF-IDF cosine silhouette,该Silhouette,用来衡量集群使用单词的明显性. 所选的框架必须使用 PA 或 UMAP 。 我们还报告原始嵌入向量的淤积。 (附录A.5提供更多信息,说明选择正确的PERC框架配置的标准以及我们如何计算每项计量.

blocks.en: After evaluating the selected framework on test companies, we use all job advertisements retained after preprocessing for monthly and occupational analytics. Figure 1 shows the complete PERC workflow.
blocks.zh: 在对试验公司的选定框架进行评估之后,我们使用预先处理后保留的所有招聘广告进行月度和职业分析。 图1显示了完整的PERC工作流程.

blocks.en: Figure 4: A set of line charts comparing TF-IDF cosine silhouette for the original MPNet vectors, PCA and UMAP across three job-ad sections. Each setting uses four K-means clusters. With UMAP, the Role task cosine silhouette rises from approximately zero with the original vectors or PCA to 0.0405. For Qualifications, UMAP reaches about 0.047 compared with about 0.010 for PCA and the original vectors, whereas Team context reaches only about 0.004. Increasing UMAP from 10 to 50 dimensions makes little difference in any panel and PCA provides little improvement over the original vectors. The higher UMAP scores indicate more similar word use within clusters relative to word use between clusters, with the largest observed increases in cosine silhouette for Role task and Qualifications.
blocks.zh: 图4:一套比较TF-IDF对MPNet原始矢量,PCA和UMAP的连线图,跨越三个待职部分. 每个设置都使用四个K-意思集群. 与UMAP一起,角色任务余弦硅胶从大约零随原向量或PCA上升至0.0405. 就资格而言,UMAP达到0.047左右,而PCA和原始矢量则为0.010左右,而Team上下文仅达到0.04左右. 将UMAP从10个维度提高到50个维度,在任何面板上都没有什么区别,PCA与原始矢量相比几乎没有什么改进. 较高的UMAP分数显示,相对于集群之间的单词使用,集群内部的单词使用更为相似,观察到的用于角色任务和资质的余弦硅声增加最多.

blocks.en: Figure 5: A series of PCA scatter plots of PERC clusters for Team context, Role task and Qualifications. Each point represents one job advertisement and each color represents a cluster, with gray representing unassigned advertisements. We can see the clearest colored regions in Qualifications, with the blue cluster concentrated on the right, the green cluster at the lower left and the pink and gold clusters above. Role task also has broad colored regions but more overlap around their boundaries, whereas Team context has several colors mixed through its center. The first two PCA components explain 11.6%–14.8% of the variance in the original job-ad vectors.
blocks.zh: 图5:常设仲裁法院关于小组背景、作用任务和资格的一系列PERC分组分布图。 每个点代表一个工作广告,每个颜色代表一个集群,灰色代表未指定广告. 可以看到"资治通鉴"中最清晰的彩色区域,蓝色集群集中在右侧,绿色集群位于左下方,上面是粉红色和金色集群. 角色任务也有广泛的颜色区域,但围绕其边界重叠较多,而团队背景则有几种颜色通过中心混合. 前两个PCA元件解释11.6%~14.8%的差值在原有的工作ad向量中.

blocks.en: 3.4 Monthly and Occupational Distribution Analytics
blocks.zh: 3.4 月度和职业分布分析

blocks.en: We calculate MMD between collections of original embedding vectors and then rank the comparisons to identify differences for GPT-6.1 Terra to inspect. We compare the same PERC cluster across months and different clusters within the same occupation and month. Each group must contain at least 30 job advertisements from five companies, and we retain up to three comparisons of each type per occupation and segmentation text input.
blocks.zh: 我们在原始嵌入向量的集合之间计算MMD,然后对比较进行排序,以识别差异,供GPT-6.1 Terra检查. 我们比较了同一PERC数月组和同一职业和数月的不同组。 每个组必须包含至少30个来自5家公司的招聘广告,我们保留了对每个职业类型和分区文本输入的最多3个比较.

blocks.en: Figure 6: A set of ranked bar charts and PCA scatter plots for Data Scientist cluster comparisons. The upper charts rank pairs by MMD and mark those inspected by GPT-6.1 Terra in blue. The lower plots show the highest-ranked selected pairs. The longest monthly-comparison bar belongs to Data Scientist cluster 1 between November 2025 and August 2026, with MMD 0.1582, and the longest same-month bar compares clusters 0 and 3 in February 2026, with MMD 0.2331. In the lower maps, the monthly samples overlap substantially and the two February clusters differ more visibly along PC 2. Several long gray bars repeat cluster 1 across other month pairs, explaining why the selected monthly comparisons also include clusters 3 and 0.
blocks.zh: 图6:用于数据科学家集群比较的一组排名条形图和五氯苯甲醚散块图。 上图按MMD排列对数,用蓝色标注GPT-6.1 Terra检查的对数。 下图显示了排名最高的选对. 2025年11月至2026年8月期间最长的月比栏属于数据科学家集群1,其中MMD 0.1582,最长的同月比栏于2026年2月比栏0和3,其中MMD 0.2331. 在下图中,每月样本大相径庭,2月2日的两组在PC2上差异较大. 几个长灰色条重复集群1跨其他月对,解释为什么选定的月比较也包括集群3和0.
