A larger score indicates that the groups differ more in their embedding distributions. We use these scores to select comparisons for GPT-6.1 Terra to inspect, without treating them as tests of statistical significance. We report the squared score as “MMD” in the figures. Appendix A.6 provides more information about why we use this form of the MMD equation, how we set the kernel bandwidth and how sample size affects the squared MMD score.
blocks.zh: 前两个术语衡量每个组内的工作描述矢量之间的平均相似性,而第三个术语则从两个组中减去矢量之间的平均相似性两倍. 较大的分数表明各组在嵌入分布上的差异较大. 我们用这些分数来选择GPT-6.1 Terra的比较来检查,而不把它们当作具有统计意义的测试. 我们报告数字中的平方分数是“MMD”。 附录A.6提供了更多信息,说明我们为什么使用这种形式的MMD方程,我们如何设置内核带宽以及样本大小如何影响平方的MMD得分.

blocks.en: After selecting the comparisons, we give GPT-6.1 Terra the full job descriptions from the two groups being compared. Each description is labeled with its cluster and posting month. We ask Terra to explain differences in purpose, applications, responsibilities, outputs and qualifications, using exact quotations from advertisements in each group. This analysis covers DS, DA, MLE and BA. The following comparison of PERC clusters, SAE features and text alone also includes SWE.
blocks.zh: 在选择比较后,我们向GPT-6.1 Terra提供了两个小组的完整职务说明。 每一份说明都与组和张贴月份贴上标签。 我们请Terra解释在目的、应用、责任、产出和资格方面的差异,并使用每一组广告中的确切引文。 这一分析涉及DS、DA、MILE和BA。 以下对PERC集群,SAE特征和单文本的比较还包括SWE.

blocks.en: 3.5 SAE Feature Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.5 SAE 特性提取

blocks.en: Figure 7: A sparse autoencoder feature-extraction workflow diagram that showcases our design for feature extraction, hypothesis generation and verification on held-out companies’ advertisements via another LLM verifier. The example shown in the figure connects a job excerpt about “building AI-workflows” to a sparse feature within Llama-8B’s latent space, and subsequently produces a hypothesis about “LLM and agent development” , supported by the quote about prototyping AI agents in GPT-6.1 Terra’s verification panel. The text examples are recorded outputs. The bars and company logos illustrate the procedure.
blocks.zh: 图7:一个稀疏的自动编码器特征提取工作流程图,通过另一个LLM验证器展示我们对被搁置公司广告的特征提取、假设生成和核实的设计。 图中所示的例子将关于 " 建立人工智能-工作流程 " 的工作节选与Llama-8B潜伏空间中的一个稀疏特征联系起来,随后提出了关于 " LLM和代理开发 " 的假说,GPT-6.1 Terra的验证面板中关于原型人工智能制剂的引文为佐证。 文字实例为记录产出。 酒吧和公司标志都说明了这个程序.

blocks.en: For the SAE analysis, we use the pretrained Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model and its matching Goodfire SAE. The SAE encoder maps each layer-19 hidden state into sparse feature activations, and its decoder reconstructs that state. Several features can activate within the same description so one posting can contain patterns associated with “developing machine learning models,” “reporting” and “collaboration”. We use the pretrained weights without fitting a new SAE to the jobs. In the following discussion, “Developing machine learning models” refers to the feature abbreviated as “Model development” in the figures.
blocks.zh: 对于SAE分析,我们使用预训的Llama-3.1-8B-指令模型及其匹配的Goodfire SAE. SAE编码器将每层-19隐藏状态映射为稀疏特征激活,其解码器重建了该状态. 一些特征可以在同样的描述中激活,因此,一个发布可以包含与“开发机器学习模型”、“报告”和“协作”有关的模式。 我们使用预先训练过的重量 却没有给工作装上新的高级高级测试 在下面的讨论中,“开发机器学习模式”是指数字中简称为“模型开发”的特征。

blocks.en: A feature counts as active when it activates on at least two source tokens in the complete section. We compare the percentage of postings activating each feature across occupations or months and then select features with large frequency differences for interpretation. Figure 7 shows the extraction and interpretation process.
blocks.zh: 当一个特性在完整部分中至少两个源令牌上激活时会算作活动. 我们比较各职业或月份中激活每个功能的张贴百分比,然后选择频率差异较大的功能进行解释。 图7显示提取和解释过程。

blocks.en: Figure 8: A series of PCA scatter plots of job-ad vectors formed from Llama SAE feature activations. Each point represents one advertisement, and its color represents the occupation. These advertisements provide the text for hypotheses about occupational or monthly differences. Role task places more Data Analyst advertisements toward the bottom and more Data Scientist advertisements toward the upper right. Team context and Qualifications show greater overlap. The first two PCA components explain 16.2%–19.1% of the variance in the job-ad vectors.
blocks.zh: 图8:一系列由Llama SAE特性激活而形成的五氯苯甲醚散射线。 每个点代表一个广告,其颜色代表职业. 这些广告提供了职业差异或月差异假设的文本。 角色任务将更多的数据分析员广告投向下方,将更多的数据科学家广告投向右上方. 团队背景和资格证明的重叠较大. 前两个PCA组件解释16.2~19.1%的工效矢量差异.

blocks.en: Figure 9: A series of PCA scatter plots of SAE features represented by their activation patterns across advertisements. Colored points highlight the selected features. In Role task, “Developing machine learning models” and “Analysis and reporting” lie farther right than “Software development.” In Qualifications, “Quantitative and computing degrees” lies farther right than “Software development skills” and “Spreadsheet and reporting skills.” The highlighted Team context features lie closer together.
blocks.zh: 图9:一系列五氯苯甲醚散射的SAE特征,其表现是它们在广告中的激活模式。 彩色点突出选定特性。 在角色任务中,“开发机器学习模型”和“分析和报告”比“软件开发”更正确。 在资格证书中,“定量和计算学位”比“软件开发技能”和“软件表和报告技能”更正确。 重点突出的小组背景特征更加密切。

blocks.en: 3.6 Using GPT-6 Luna to Label Features and Generate Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 3.6 使用 GPT-6 Luna 标记特性并生成假说

blocks.en: For each comparison, we select up to 200 features whose activation frequencies differ by more than 3%. For each feature, GPT-6 Luna reads up to ten activating and ten nonactivating job-ad sections. We mark the activating text in the active examples so it can describe what the feature appears to capture. We remove unclear labels and labels about syntax or website boilerplate.
blocks.zh: 对于每次比较,我们选择了多达200个特性,其激活频率差异超过3%. 对于每个功能,GPT-6 Luna读取最多10个激活部分和10个不激活待职部分。 我们在活动示例中标注激活文本,以便它能够描述该特性似乎能够捕捉到什么. 我们删除关于语法或网站锅炉板的不明确标签和标签.

blocks.en: Figure 10: A series of bar charts that compares SAE feature activation rates across five occupations. Each row represents a segmented job-description section, and each individual chart represents one sparse feature. Each bar represents an occupation and gives the percentage of its advertisements in which the feature activates. The label n n denotes the number of advertisements. “Developing machine learning models” peaks in Data Scientist and Machine Learning Engineer at 79.2% and 71.0%, “Analysis and reporting” in Business Analyst at 85.0% and “Software development” in Software Engineer at 61.5%. “Software development skills” activates most often in Software Engineer and “Spreadsheet and reporting skills” in Data Analyst and Business Analyst. Team context rates remain below 20%.
blocks.zh: 图10:一系列条形图,比较五个职业的SAE特征激活率. 每行代表一个分割的岗位描述部分,每个单独的图表代表一个稀少的特征. 每个酒吧代表一个职业,并给出其广告中该功能激活的百分比. 标签nn表示广告数量. “开发机器学习模型”在数据科学家和机器学习工程师中占79.2%和71.0%,在业务分析师中占85.0%,在软件工程师中占61.5%。 “软件开发技能”在软件工程师和数据分析员和业务分析员中最经常地激活“软件开发技能”。 团队背景率仍然低于20%。

blocks.en: Figure 11: A collection of job-ad excerpts that shows where the nine SAE features shown here activate. Pink highlights words containing activating tokens and ellipses mark omitted text. The highlighted words connect the feature names to specific passages: “Developing machine learning models” activates around developing, testing and evaluating “machine learning models”, and the “Quantitative and computing degrees” feature activates around fields such as computer science and statistics. Other highlights fall on broader wording such as “interfaces” and “activities” in the “Finance and trading” example or “and” in the “Spreadsheet and reporting skills” example. The highlighted passages shown in the figure show why we interpret each activation in its surrounding text.
blocks.zh: 图11:工作指导节选集,显示此处显示的9个SAE特征在哪里激活. 粉红色突出显示包含激活符和椭圆标记的单词省略文本. 突出的词将特征名称与具体段落联系起来:“开发机器学习模型”围绕“机器学习模型”的开发、测试和评价激活,“定量和计算学位”特征围绕计算机科学和统计等领域激活。 其他的要点涉及更广泛的措辞,如“财务和贸易”实例中的“界面”和“活动”或“桌面和报告技能”实例中的“和”。 图中突出的段落显示了我们为什么在其周围文本中解释每次激活。

blocks.en: After this, GPT-6 Luna combines related labels into at most ten hypotheses per comparison. A hypothesis is a claim proposed by GPT-6 Luna about the differences in the Role task, Team context or Qualifications described by two occupations. For monthly comparisons, the claim describes differences between two posting months within the same occupation. For example, “LLM and agent workflow development is more common in MLE than DS tasks” covers building or evaluating those workflows and excludes general ML work. We keep each definition unchanged when checking descriptions from held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 在此之后,GPT-6 Luna将相关标签结合到每次比较最多十种假设. 一种假设是GPT-6 Luna就两个职业描述的角色任务,团队背景或资格的不同而提出的主张. 就每月比较而言,索赔描述了同一职业内两个工作月之间的差异。 例如,“LLM和代理工作流程的开发比DS任务在MLE中更为常见”,涵盖这些工作流程的构建或评价,不包括一般的ML工作. 在检查被扣留公司的说明时,我们不改变每个定义。

blocks.en: 3.7 Comparing the Methods and Checking the Proposed Differences
blocks.zh: 3.7 比较方法和检查拟议差异

blocks.en: To compare the methods fairly, GPT-6 Luna reads the same complete job-ad sections under three conditions. In the PERC condition, it also receives cluster assignments and distribution scores, and in the SAE condition it receives feature labels and activating examples. In the text-only condition, it reads the descriptions without either representation. GPT-6 Luna generates the hypotheses under all three conditions using the same hypothesis limit and maximum generation budget.
blocks.zh: 为了公平地比较这些方法,GPT-6 Luna在三个条件下读取了同样的完整的工作指导部分. 在PERC条件中,它也获得集群任务和发行分数,在SAE条件中它获得特征标签和激活实例. 在仅以文字为条件的情况下,它只读说明,而无任何说明。 GPT-6 Luna在所有三个条件下都使用相同的假设极限和最大生成预算生成假设.

blocks.en: We then ask GPT-6.1 Terra to check whether each proposed characteristic is present, absent or unclear in descriptions from held-out companies and provide an exact quote for each positive judgment. This tells us whether the pattern extends beyond the postings used to propose it. We compare the proportions judged present after selecting advertisements with similar formats and section lengths, using the same posting month for occupation comparisons. We also remove duplicate text between the two stages.
blocks.zh: 然后,我们请GPT-6.1 Terra检查每个拟议特征是否都存在,被搁置公司的说明是否不存在或不明确,并为每个积极判断提供确切的引文。 这告诉我们这个模式是否超越了用来提出它的帖子. 我们比较了在选择具有类似格式和章节长度的广告后所判断的比例,并使用同一个公布月份进行职业比较。 我们还删除两个阶段之间的重复文本。

blocks.en: We report company-aware confidence intervals and adjust for testing many hypotheses using Benjamini–Hochberg (BH) and the more conservative Benjamini–Yekutieli (BY) procedures. (Appendix E.1 provides more information about how we sample the descriptions and test the proposed differences.) These checks support differences in the selected samples, with the source quotes explaining what those differences mean about the jobs.
blocks.zh: 我们用Benjamini-Hochberg(BH)和较保守的Benjamini-Yekutieli(BY)程序, (附录E.1提供了更多信息,说明我们如何对描述进行抽样,并测试拟议的差异。 ) 这些检查支持了所选样本的差异,资料来源引用了这些差异对工作的意义。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4 评价

blocks.en: To evaluate the two approaches, we first examine how PERC groups job advertisements and then inspect the SAE features that activate within those groups. After this, we compare the claims that GPT-6 Luna generates when it reads descriptions with PERC clusters, with SAE features or as text alone, and ask GPT-6.1 Terra to check those claims in advertisements from held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这两种办法,我们首先审查PERC如何组合招聘广告,然后检查这些群组中激活的SAE特征。 在此之后,我们比较了GPT-6 Luna在读取描述与PERC集群,具有SAE特征或仅作为文本时产生的声称,并要求GPT-6.1 Terra在被搁置公司的广告中检查这些声称.

blocks.en: 4.1 Selected PERC Frameworks
blocks.zh: 4.1 部分五氯苯酚 框架

blocks.en: After comparing the seven segmentation text inputs, we select a PERC configuration for each input using the criteria described in Section 3 . Table 1 shows that Role task and Role task + Qualifications use UMAP with K-means, whereas Team context uses PCA with hierarchical agglomerative clustering. Role task + Qualifications has the highest TF-IDF cosine silhouette at 0.064, compared with 0.008 for Team context + Qualifications, so these selected clusters differ more in their word use when we combine tasks with qualifications.
blocks.zh: 在比较了七个分区文本输入后,我们使用第3节描述的标准,为每个输入选择一个PERC配置. 表1显示角色任务和角色任务+资质使用带有K元素的UMAP,而Team上下文则使用具有分级群集的PCA. 角色任务+资格赛在0.064位是TF-IDF宇宙硅胶最高的,而团队背景+资格赛则只有0.008位,因此当我们把任务与资格合并时,这些选定的分组在字面使用上的差异更大.

blocks.en: To examine whether these clusters also separate in the original embedding space, we calculate vector silhouette scores and obtain scores between 0.014 and 0.091. These small positive scores indicate that there is substantial overlap between descriptions, which we also observe in the two-dimensional maps in Figure 5 . We therefore use the clusters to examine related work within the advertisements without assuming that each cluster represents a separate profession.
blocks.zh: 为了检查这些集群是否在原始嵌入空间中也分开,我们计算了矢量硅声分数,获得0.014至0.091之间的分数. 这些小的正分数表明,描述之间有很大的重叠,我们也在图5中的二维图中观察到了这一点. 因此,我们利用各组来审查广告中的有关工作,而不假定每一组代表一个单独的专业。

blocks.en: We also compare cluster assignments across repeated runs using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI). The four configurations using hierarchical agglomerative clustering have an ARI of one because they repeat the same assignments on the same data, whereas Role task has an ARI of 0.781. This comparison measures changes across runs on the same advertisements, and the evaluation on held-out companies examines whether the selected configurations also group advertisements from different employers. (Appendix B provides the full configuration results and the measurements on held-out companies.)
blocks.zh: 我们还使用调整后的兰德指数(ARI)对重复进行的集群任务进行比较。 使用分级星团组合的四种配置有一个ARI,因为它们在同一数据上重复相同的任务,而角色任务ARI为0.781。 这种比较措施在同一个广告上发生了变化,对被搁置公司的评价则审查所选配置是否也包括来自不同雇主的集团广告。 (附录B提供全部配置结果和对被搁置公司的测量. )

blocks.en: Table 1: Selected PERC configurations and validation results for the seven text inputs. Role task + Qualifications achieves the highest word separation (0.064), while Team context + Role task has the highest embedding-space silhouette (0.091). The silhouette score here measures separation in the original embeddings. Word separation (sep.) reports the TF-IDF cosine silhouette score, which measures how similar word use is within each cluster compared with the nearest other cluster, and ARI (or Adjusted Rand Index) measures how consistently the same advertisements are grouped across repeated runs and after accounting for chance. Assigned % gives the percentage of validation advertisements assigned to a cluster, which measures how much of the validation sample the clustering method covers.
blocks.zh: 表1:7文本输入部分PERC配置和验证结果. 角色任务 + 资格实现最高的单词分离(0.064),而Team context + 角色任务具有最高的嵌入-空间 silhouette(0.091). 这里的分数测量原始嵌入物中的分离. Word discription (sep.) 报告 TF-IDF cosine silhouette 分数,该分数衡量每个组内与最近的其他组组相比的类似词的使用,ARI(或经调整的兰德指数)衡量相同广告在重复运行和计及机会后如何一致地分组. 指定 % 给出了分配给一个集群的验证广告的百分比,用于衡量集群方法覆盖的验证样本的多少.

blocks.en: 4.2 SAE Features Within Selected PERC Clusters
blocks.zh: 4.2 选定PERC内的SAE特征 集群

blocks.en: To examine what the PERC clusters contain, we apply the SAE to the complete selected section of every advertisement in three comparisons chosen by MMD. These comparisons cover Data Scientist Team context in February 2026, Business Analyst Role task in April versus September 2026, and Data Scientist Qualifications in December 2025.
blocks.zh: 为了检查PERC集群包含的内容,我们将SAE应用到MMD所选择的三次比较中的每一条广告的完整部分. 这些比较涵盖2026年2月的数据科学家团队背景,2026年4月对9月的商业分析师角色任务,2025年12月的数据科学家资格.

blocks.en: Figure 12: A set of PCA feature maps for different occupations and segmentation text inputs. Each row compares extracted SAE features between two PERC cluster samples from the same occupation and job-description section. Each point represents an individual feature. For the first two columns, the greater the blue intensity, the greater the percentage of job advertisements in which the feature activates as Llama-3.1-8B reads the section. The last column is the difference between the percentages of jobs in which each feature activated in one cluster versus the other cluster, with the pink color scheme representing a higher activation of features in the second cluster compared to the first cluster. In the Team context of Data Scientist roles, the marked feature activates in 38/39 advertisements in cluster 3 and none of 64 in cluster 2. In the Role task section of Business Analyst roles, we compare the same cluster in April and September, where the pink and blue regions represent features that activate in a greater or smaller percentage of September advertisements. In the Qualifications of Data Scientist roles, the blue regions represent features that activate in a smaller percentage of cluster 2 advertisements than in cluster 0 advertisements.
blocks.zh: 图12:一套不同职业和分区文字输入的常设仲裁法院特征图。 每行比较从同一职业和职务说明部分抽取的两个PERC集群样本之间的SAE特征. 每个点都代表个人特征. 对于前两栏,蓝色强度越大,该功能在Llama-3.1-8B读取该节时激活的招聘广告的百分比就越高. 最后一栏是每个特性在一个集群中激活的工作百分比与另一个集群的不同,粉色色方案代表第二个集群中特性的激活率高于第一个集群. 在数据科学家角色的团队背景下,该标志性特征在第3组的38/39号广告中激活,64个广告中没有启动。 2. 国家 在业务分析员角色的角色任务科中,我们比较了4月和9月的同一组,粉色和蓝色区域代表了在9月广告中多或少激活的特征. 在"数据科学家角色资格"(Qualification of Data Scientist)中,蓝色区域代表了在第二组广告中激活的功能,比第0组广告中激活的功能要小.

blocks.en: For each comparison, Figure 12 places the SAE features at the same PCA coordinates so that we can compare their activation percentages between the two PERC cluster samples. Each point represents one feature, and its color represents the percentage of advertisements in which that feature activates. We also use K-means to group features that activate in similar descriptions, then average their activation percentages within each feature group to examine whether the differences extend across related features. (Appendix E.3 provides the feature-group maps and explains how we calculate these averages.)
blocks.zh: 每次比较 图12将SAE特征置于同一个PCA坐标上,以便我们可以比较两个PERC集群样本中的激活百分比。 每个点代表一个特征,其颜色代表该特征激活的广告的百分比. 我们还使用K-意指在类似描述中激活的组特征,然后在每个组特征中平均激活百分比,以检查差异是否扩展到相关特征之间. (附录E.3提供了特征组图,并解释了我们如何计算这些平均值. )

blocks.en: In the Team context of Data Scientist roles, the feature labeled “health- and insurance-sector work” activates in 38/39 advertisements in cluster 3 and none of 64 in cluster 2. When we read the descriptions in cluster 3, we find references to genomics research, clinical operations and drug development, which connect this activation pattern to the healthcare work described in GPT-6.1 Terra’s PERC narrative.
blocks.zh: 在 " 数据科学家 " 角色方面, " 健康和保险部门工作 " 这一特点在第3组第38/39号广告中激活,第64个则没有启动。 2. 国家 当我们读到第3组的描述时,我们会找到基因组学研究、临床操作和药物开发的参考文献,这些参考文献将这种激活模式与GPT-6.1 Terra的PERC说明中所述的保健工作联系起来。

blocks.en: For the Role task section of Business Analyst roles, we compare the same PERC cluster in April and September. In Figure 12 , the pink and blue regions show that some features activate in a higher percentage of September advertisements and others in a lower percentage. When we average these percentages within each group of related SAE features, however, the April and September averages differ by at most 3.1%. These averages can therefore look similar even when individual features activate in different percentages of advertisements across the two months.
blocks.zh: 关于业务分析员角色的作用任务科,我们在4月和9月比较了同一PERC组。 在图12中,粉红色和蓝色区域显示,有些特征在9月广告中激活的百分比较高,而其他特征激活的百分比较低。 然而,当我们平均在每一组相关最高审计实体中所占百分比时,4月和9月的平均数最多为3.1%。 因此,即使在两个月内不同比例的广告中激活个人特征时,这些平均数也可能看起来相似。

blocks.en: For the Qualifications of Data Scientist roles, all ten feature groups have a lower average activation percentage in cluster 2 than in cluster 0. To interpret this difference, we also compare the length of the qualification sections and find a median of 55 tokens in cluster 2 compared with 140 in cluster 0. The lower activation percentages therefore occur in the cluster with shorter descriptions, so the comparison includes a difference in how much qualification text the SAE reads.
blocks.zh: 对于数据科学家角色的资格,所有10个特征组在第2组的平均激活率低于第0组. 为了解释这一差别,我们还比较了资格限制部分的长度,发现第2组的中间值为55个令牌,而第2组为140个令牌。 零点 因此,较低的激活百分比出现在描述较短的集群中,因此比较包括了SAE读取的限定文本的差别.

blocks.en: 4.3 SAE Features Across Occupations and Posting Periods
blocks.zh: 4.3 SAE 各种职业和职位的特征

blocks.en: After examining the selected clusters, we compare features across the five occupations in Figure 10 . For example, “Developing machine learning models” activates in 79.2% of the selected Data Scientist advertisements and 71.0% of the selected Machine Learning Engineer advertisements, and “Analysis and reporting” activates in 85.0% of the selected Business Analyst advertisements. Because several features can activate in one description, we can examine overlapping characteristics of the work without assigning every advertisement to only one feature.
blocks.zh: 在审查了选定的集群之后,我们在图10中比较了五个职业的特点。 例如,“开发机器学习模型”在选定的79.2%的数据科学家广告和71.0%的机器学习工程师广告中激活,“分析和报告”在选定的85.0%的商业分析员广告中激活。 因为多个特性可以在一个描述中激活,所以我们可以检查作品的重叠特性,而不将每个广告只分配到一个特性.

blocks.en: To examine whether SAE activations also respond to how descriptions are written, we inspect the separate Gemma SAE analysis of the full dataset in Figures 13 and 14 .
blocks.zh: 为了检查SAE激活是否也响应描述的写法,我们检查图13和图14中完整的数据集的Gemma SAE单独分析.

blocks.en: Figure 13: A grouped bar chart that compares posting periods within clusters formed from Gemma SAE features. For each job-description section, pink represents the percentage of advertisements matching their cluster’s most common posting period, and blue represents the percentage in the dataset’s most common posting period. We separate the periods at January 2026. Pink exceeds blue in every section, reaching about 93% compared with 50% for Qualifications and full descriptions, so the clusters separate earlier and later advertisements. These periods also differ in description format and length.
blocks.zh: 图13:一个分组条形图,比较由Gemma SAE特性形成的集群内的张贴期。 对于每个职务说明部分,粉色表示与其群组最常见的张贴期相匹配的广告的百分比,蓝色表示数据集最常见张贴期的百分比。 我们在2026年1月分期 粉色在每一节中都超过了蓝色,与"资格"和完整描述的50%相比,达到约93%,因此各集将早期和后期的广告分开. 这些时期在描述格式和长度方面也有所不同.

blocks.en: In this analysis, the Role task clusters largely separate advertisements posted before January 2026 from those posted in January 2026 or later, with 89.2% of advertisements matching the most common posting period in their cluster. Two analytics clusters also differ in median description length, at 39 and 160 tokens, so the visible separation also needs to be understood alongside differences in format and text length. For the subsequent method comparison, we therefore match advertisements with similarly formatted descriptions and comparable section lengths to reduce these differences. (Appendix D provides more information about the Gemma SAE analysis.)
blocks.zh: 在这项分析中,角色任务组主要将2026年1月前张贴的广告与2026年1月或以后张贴的广告分开,89.2%的广告与其组中最常见的发布期相匹配. 两个分析组在中位描述长度上也有差异,分别是39和160令牌,因此可见的分离还需要与格式和文本长度的差异一起理解. 因此,为了进行随后的方法比较,我们将广告与格式类似的说明和可比较的章节长度相匹配,以减少这些差异。 (附录D提供更多关于Gemma SAE分析的信息.

blocks.en: Figure 14: A series of PCA scatter plots of job-ad vectors formed from Gemma SAE feature activations. Each point represents one advertisement and its color represents the cluster. The Gemma SAE projection separates Qualifications into two broad sides, with blue and brown clusters on the left and pink, green and gray clusters on the right. Role task forms a more continuous cloud with different colors concentrated in its corners, and Team context shows several regions joined through an overlapping center. Together with the posting-period comparison in Figure 13 , these maps show that visible grouping can reflect description format and length as well as work content.
blocks.zh: 图14:由Gemma SAE特性激活而形成的一系列五氯苯甲醚散射线。 每个点代表一个广告,其颜色代表集群. Gemma SAE投影将Qualicts分离成两个宽面,左侧为蓝色和棕色集群,右侧为粉红色,绿色和灰色集群. 角色任务形成一个更连续的云层,不同的颜色集中在它的角落,Team背景显示有多个区域通过重叠的中心加入. 这些地图连同图13中的张贴期比较显示,可见的分组可以反映描述格式和长度以及工作内容.

blocks.en: 4.4 Comparison of the Insights
blocks.zh: 4.4 见解比较

blocks.en: To compare what the two frameworks add to language-model reading, we give GPT-6 Luna the same job-ad sections under three conditions: accompanied by PERC clusters, accompanied by SAE features or without either representation. A hypothesis is a claim proposed by GPT-6 Luna about the differences in the Role task, Team context or Qualifications described by two occupations. For monthly comparisons, GPT-6 Luna makes the same kind of claim about two posting months within one occupation.
blocks.zh: 为了比较这两个框架在语言模型读取中增加的内容,我们在三个条件下给GPT-6 Luna提供相同的读取工作段:附带PERC集群,附带SAE特性或没有任何一种代表. 一种假设是GPT-6 Luna就两个职业描述的角色任务,团队背景或资格的不同而提出的主张. 就每月比较而言,GPT-6 Luna在一个职业内大约两个月内提出同样的索赔。

blocks.en: With SAE features, GPT-6 Luna generates 26 occupational claims for the Data Scientist–Data Analyst and Machine Learning Engineer–Data Scientist comparisons, compared with 20 using PERC clusters and 22 using text alone. For the Software Engineer comparisons, PERC inputs lead to 29 claims compared with 24 under each remaining condition. These counts show that the number of candidate differences depends on both the input and the occupations compared. More claims give us more possibilities to investigate, but several claims can overlap or fail to appear in held-out advertisements, so the counts alone cannot establish which method produces better insights.
blocks.zh: 具有SAE特征的GPT-6 Luna为数据科学家-数据分析员和机器学习工程师-数据科学家的比较生成26项职业索赔,而使用PERC集群的有20项,仅使用文本的有22项。 就软件工程师的比较而言,PERC投入导致29项索赔,而其余每个条件下为24项。 这些计算表明,候选人差异的数量取决于所比较的投入和职业。 更多的权利主张给我们更多的调查机会,但若干权利主张可能重叠或未能出现在被搁置的广告中,因此仅凭这些理由无法确定哪种方法会产生更好的见解。

blocks.en: After generating the hypotheses, GPT-6.1 Terra reads advertisements from held-out companies and checks whether the characteristic described in each claim appears in each description. For example, when GPT-6 Luna uses PERC clusters to propose a claim about “developing machine learning models,” GPT-6.1 Terra finds that characteristic in 60/98 Data Scientist task sections and 7/98 Data Analyst task sections. When GPT-6 Luna uses SAE features, the corresponding counts are 48/98 and 5/98 under its resulting definition. Both comparisons support the same occupational contrast, although the definitions describe somewhat different sets of tasks. Section 5 explains these differences using the source descriptions and advertisement counts.
blocks.zh: 生成假设后,GPT-6.1 Terra阅读被搁置公司的广告,并检查每项索赔中描述的特征是否出现在每一描述中。 例如,当GPT-6 Luna利用PERC集群提出“开发机器学习模型”的主张时,GPT-6.1 Terra在60/98数据科学家任务部分和7/98数据分析员任务部分发现了这一特征。 当GPT-6 Luna使用SAE特性时,相应的计数在其产生的定义下为48/98和5/98. 这两种比较都支持同样的职业对比,尽管定义描述了一些不同的任务。 第5节用来源说明和广告计数来解释这些差异。

blocks.en: The Business Analyst and monthly comparisons also contain examples of different work, but none passes the correction for multiple tests. We therefore report the observed characteristics and their sample sizes without treating those examples as established differences across the wider job market.
blocks.zh: 业务分析师和月度比较中也包含不同工作的例子,但没有通过多次测试的校正. 因此,我们报告观察到的特征及其样本规模,而不把这些例子作为整个就业市场的既定差异。

blocks.en: The three conditions also differ in API cost. Across the Data Scientist, Data Analyst and Machine Learning Engineer comparisons, labeling SAE features and generating hypotheses costs $17.50, compared with $0.28 when GPT-6 Luna uses PERC clusters and $0.31 when it reads the text without either representation. These amounts exclude shared verification and local computation, so they compare the API cost of preparing and generating the hypotheses. (Appendix E.1 provides the costs and statistical test results for each comparison study.)
blocks.zh: 这三个条件在API成本上也有差异. 在整个数据科学家、数据分析员和机器学习工程师的比较中,将SAE特性贴上标签并产生假说的费用为17.50美元,相比之下,GPT-6 Luna使用PERC集群时为0.28美元,阅读文本时为0.31美元,没有表示。 这些金额不包括共享核实和当地计算,因此它们比较了编制和生成假设的API成本. (附录E.1提供了每项比较研究的成本和统计测试结果。 )

blocks.en: 5 What the Job Advertisements Tell Us About the Work
blocks.zh: 页:1 工作广告告诉我们的工作

blocks.en: Employers often ask for similar programming tools but expect applicants to use them for different purposes. Their descriptions ask applicants to develop “machine learning models”, maintain reports or build applications, so we examine Team context, Role task and Qualifications together. Most of our advertisements describe internships, so these findings primarily describe the work offered to interns at the companies in our dataset.
blocks.zh: 雇主往往要求提供类似的编程工具,但期望申请人将这些工具用于不同目的。 他们的描述要求申请人制定“机器学习模式”,保持报告或建立申请,因此我们一起审查小组的背景、作用任务和资格。 我们大多数的广告都描述了实习,所以这些调查结果主要描述了我们数据集中提供给公司实习生的工作.

blocks.en: 5.1 Data Scientists Build Machine Learning Models and Data Analysts Track Business Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据科学家 构建机器学习模式和数据分析师跟踪业务业绩

blocks.en: Data Scientist advertisements more often describe developing “machine learning models” to answer a question or predict an outcome, whereas Data Analyst advertisements more often describe reports and dashboards that help a business understand its performance. The difference is therefore in what the employer expects the analysis to produce, even when both jobs involve programming and working with data.
blocks.zh: 数据科学家的广告更经常地描述开发“机器学习模型”以回答问题或预测结果,而数据分析员的广告更经常描述有助于企业了解其业绩的报告和仪表板。 因此,差别在于雇主期望分析产生什么,即使这两种工作都涉及方案拟订和数据工作。

blocks.en: Reporting also appears in Data Scientist work, particularly when the applicant is expected to explain the results of an analysis. This helps distinguish preparing a report to communicate a finding from maintaining reports that a team uses regularly. In these descriptions, the main distinction is whether the employer needs a new analytical result or dependable information about its ongoing operations.
blocks.zh: 报告也出现在数据科学家的工作中,特别是当申请人被要求解释分析结果时。 这有助于将编写报告以传达调查结果与保留一个小组经常使用的报告区分开来。 在这些描述中,主要区别在于雇主是否需要新的分析结果或关于其正在进行的业务的可靠信息。

blocks.en: The qualifications follow a similar pattern. Data Scientist advertisements place more emphasis on “statistical and machine learning methods”, and Data Analyst advertisements more often ask for “spreadsheet, reporting and visualization skills”. Both roles can require programming, so a list of languages alone gives an incomplete picture of the job.
blocks.zh: 资历也遵循类似的模式。 数据科学家的广告更加强调“统计和机器学习方法”,数据分析员的广告更经常要求“电子表格、报告和可视化技能”。 这两个角色都可能需要编程,因此单是语言列表就给出了该工作的不完整图景.

blocks.en: 5.2 Machine Learning Engineers Put Machine Learning Models into Working Applications
blocks.zh: 5.2 机器学习工程师将机器学习模式纳入工作应用程序

blocks.en: Figure 15: A pair of bar charts comparing the work described in Data Scientist and Data Analyst advertisements on the left, and Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist advertisements on the right. Each bar represents the percentage of checked advertisements describing the given activity, and the labels distinguish findings from the PERC and SAE comparisons. Data Scientist advertisements more often describe “developing machine learning models,” and Data Analyst advertisements more often describe “reporting.” The right panel shows a stronger emphasis on “building and operating AI applications” in Machine Learning Engineer advertisements, compared with “analysis used to inform business decisions” in Data Scientist advertisements.
blocks.zh: 图15:对左边的数据科学家和数据分析员广告和右边的机器学习工程师和数据科学家广告中描述的工作进行比较的一对条形图. 每个栏代表了描述特定活动的被检查广告的百分比,标签将结果与PERC和SAE的比较区分开来. 数据科学家的广告更常描述“开发机器学习模式”,数据分析员的广告更常描述“报告”。 与数据科学家广告中“为商业决策提供依据的分析”相比,正确的小组显示在机器学习工程师广告中更加强调“建立和操作AI应用程序”。

blocks.en: Machine Learning Engineer advertisements describe work that extends from developing “machine learning models” to making them usable in an application. Employers ask applicants to connect “machine learning models” to software, build the processes that prepare their data and check how the “machine learning models” behave once they are in use. This places more emphasis on operating an AI application than we observe in Data Scientist advertisements focused on answering analytical questions.
blocks.zh: 机器学习工程师广告描述了从开发“机器学习模型”到将其用于应用的工作。 雇主要求申请人将“机器学习模型”与软件连接起来,建立编制数据的程序,并检查“机器学习模型”一旦使用后是如何运作的。 这比我们在数据科学家广告中观察到的更注重操作AI应用程序,侧重于解答分析问题.

blocks.en: Some descriptions also involve applications of language models and AI agents, including retrieving information, connecting language models to tools and testing how these systems work. These examples show that the engineering work around “machine learning models” can be a substantial part of the role, giving these jobs a strong software-engineering component alongside developing “machine learning models”.
blocks.zh: 一些描述还涉及语言模型和AI代理的应用,包括检索信息,将语言模型与工具连接起来,测试这些系统是如何工作的. 这些例子表明,围绕“机器学习模式”的工程工作可成为这一作用的一个重要部分,使这些工作在开发“机器学习模式”的同时具有强大的软件工程组成部分。

blocks.en: 5.3 Business Analysts Also Build Dashboards and Reports
blocks.zh: 5.3 业务分析员还构建了编板和报告

blocks.en: Figure 16: A set of bar charts comparing the work described in Business Analyst advertisements with Data Analyst and Data Scientist advertisements. Each bar represents the percentage of checked advertisements describing the given activity. Business Analyst descriptions include “gathering business requirements” as well as “building dashboards”, whereas Data Analyst descriptions more often emphasize “preparing data” and Data Scientist descriptions more often emphasize “developing predictive machine learning models”. These examples show that while there exists overlap between the two ’Analyst’ titles, they are still fundamentally different in general of as one focuses more on aligning with business requirements while the other focuses more on untangling data to find raw data insights.
blocks.zh: 图16:一套条形图,比较商业分析员广告中描述的工作与数据分析员和数据科学家广告. 每个栏目代表所检查的广告中描述特定活动的百分比。 业务分析员的描述包括“收集业务要求”和“建筑仪表板”,而数据分析员的描述更经常强调“准备数据”,数据科学家的描述更经常强调“发展预测机器学习模型”。 这些例子表明,虽然两个 " 分析 " 的标题之间有重叠之处,但总的来说,它们仍然大不相同,因为一个更注重与业务要求保持一致,另一个更注重整理数据以找到原始数据见解。

blocks.en: In our small Business Analyst sample, several descriptions connect understanding a business request with building something that meets it. Employers ask applicants to gather requirements, explain how a process should work and specify how a team will know whether the result meets its needs. Several of those same descriptions also include building reports or dashboards, so the role can involve carrying a business request through to a working analytical tool.
blocks.zh: 在我们的小商业分析师样本中,一些描述将理解业务请求与构建满足它的东西联系起来. 雇主要求申请人收集要求,解释一个程序应如何运作,并具体说明一个小组如何知道结果是否满足其需要。 其中一些说明还包括建筑报告或仪表板,因此,这种作用可能涉及将业务请求传递到工作分析工具。

blocks.en: One advertisement connects gathering business requirements with building Power BI reports, checking data quality and testing AI applications. The reporting work overlaps with Data Analyst responsibilities, so employers in these examples use the Business Analyst title for roles that also include practical data work. The descriptions accept both business and computing or quantitative study backgrounds, consistent with work that connects business needs to technical implementation.
blocks.zh: 一份广告将收集业务要求与建筑Power BI报告联系起来,检查数据质量并测试AI应用程序. 报告工作与数据分析师的职责重叠,因此在这些例子中,雇主使用商业分析师的头衔来扮演也包括实用数据工作的角色. 描述既接受业务背景,也接受计算或定量研究背景,符合将业务需求与技术实施联系起来的工作.

blocks.en: 5.4 The Same Job Title Can Mean Very Different Work
blocks.zh: 5.4 国家 同一职称可以表示 非常不一样的工作

blocks.en: The setting in which a team works changes the questions an applicant would be expected to answer. Within Data Science, we find descriptions about improving manufacturing quality alongside descriptions about disease research and healthcare operations. Forecasting demand for spare parts and studying genetic changes can involve similar analytical methods, but the data, decisions and background knowledge involved are different.
blocks.zh: 团队工作的环境改变了申请人应回答的问题。 在数据科学中,我们发现关于改进制造质量的说明,以及关于疾病研究和保健业务的说明。 预测对零件的需求和研究基因变化可能涉及类似的分析方法,但所涉及的数据、决定和背景知识是不同的。

blocks.en: The same distinction appears in Data Analyst advertisements. Some focus on retail inventory and business performance, and others examine healthcare costs, patient outcomes or clinical data. Meanwhile, Business Analyst advertisements differ in whether the applicant would maintain reporting tools or use their results to help plan a business activity. At TikTok, for example, one description focuses on building dashboards and another on analyzing seller activity to inform incentive decisions.
blocks.zh: " 数据分析 " 广告中也有同样的区别。 有些侧重于零售库存和商业业绩,另一些则审查保健费用、病人结果或临床数据。 同时,业务分析员的广告在申请人是否保留报告工具或使用其结果帮助规划商业活动方面有所不同。 例如,在TikTok,一种描述侧重于建造仪表板,另一种则侧重于分析卖方的活动,以便为奖励决定提供信息。

blocks.en: Entry requirements also vary within a shared title. Some Data Scientist internships accept programming experience gained through coursework, whereas others require enrollment in a related graduate program. For an applicant, the team’s purpose, the work described and the study requirements therefore give a more useful picture of a role than its title alone. (Appendix C provides the company examples and source passages for these comparisons.)
blocks.zh: 在共同所有权范围内,条目要求也各不相同。 一些数据科学家实习人员接受通过课程工作获得的编程经验,而另一些则要求参加相关的研究生课程。 因此,对于申请人来说,小组的目的、所描述的工作和研究要求比其单独的标题更能说明作用。 (附录C为这些比较提供了公司实例和源段落. )

blocks.en: 5.5 The Projects Described Differ Across Months
blocks.zh: 5.5 描述各月差异的项目

blocks.en: When we compare advertisements across months, we observe differences in the projects employers describe within the same occupation. For Data Scientist roles, the February 2026 examples include infrastructure planning and search-performance reporting, and the September examples include analyzing vineyard images, working with satellite data and using AI to assist work. These descriptions involve different uses of data science, even though the occupation name remains the same.
blocks.zh: 当我们对几个月的广告进行比较时,我们发现雇主在同一职业中描述的项目存在差异。 关于数据科学家的角色,2026年2月的例子包括基础设施规划和搜索业绩报告,9月的例子包括葡萄园图像分析,与卫星数据合作以及利用AI协助工作. 这些描述涉及数据科学的不同用途,尽管占领名称保持不变.

blocks.en: Machine Learning Engineer advertisements show a similar difference between financial-software work in November 2025 and projects involving finding relevant information, processing data and using “machine learning models” to predict vehicle movement in December. For Data Analyst roles, October 2025 reporting descriptions contrast with March 2026 examples involving product experiments and AI agents that query analytical reports. AI-related work already appears in the earlier advertisements, so these examples show different uses of AI across the two months.
blocks.zh: 机器学习工程师广告显示,2025年11月的财务软件工作与涉及寻找相关信息、处理数据以及使用“机器学习模型”预测12月车辆行驶情况的项目之间有类似差异。 对于数据分析师的角色,2025年10月的报告描述与2026年3月涉及产品实验和查询分析报告的AI代理的例子形成对比. 与AI相关的作品已经出现在早期的广告中,因此这些例子显示了在两个月中AI的不同用途.

blocks.en: For Business Analyst roles, April 2026 examples focus on reporting and operational planning, and September examples include client consulting, predictive analysis and examining possible business scenarios. Taken together, these comparisons show how the applications of a role can differ across the advertisements available at different times. The employers and positions also differ between months, so we are observing different advertised projects rather than following the same employees as their responsibilities change. (Appendix C provides the monthly examples and their source descriptions.)
blocks.zh: 关于业务分析员的作用,2026年4月的例子侧重于报告和业务规划,9月的例子包括客户咨询、预测分析和审查可能的业务设想。 综合起来,这些比较表明,在不同时间,一个角色的应用在不同广告中如何不同。 雇主和职位也因月而异,因此,我们观察的是不同的广告项目,而不是随着雇员职责的改变而跟踪同样的雇员。 (附录C提供每月实例及其来源描述. )

blocks.en: 5.6 Reporting and Experiment Design Vary Across Months
blocks.zh: 5.6 报告和实验设计

blocks.en: Figure 17: A pair of line charts showing how often checked Data Analyst advertisements describe reporting work and Data Scientist advertisements describe designing experiments across posting months. Each line represents the percentage of advertisements containing the given activity, and the shaded areas represent uncertainty around those estimates. The percentage of jobs that requires “Business intelligence reporting work” fluctuates across the months, while “causal experimental design work” demand fluctuates less but with generally lower in demand. Due to technical errors in our data collection process, we exhibit a gap across june and july that we instead construct an interpolation estimate for.
blocks.zh: 图17:一对线性图表,显示被检查的数据分析员广告如何经常描述报告工作,数据科学家广告描述整个张贴月的设计实验. 每行代表包含特定活动的广告的百分比,而阴影区则代表这些估计数的不确定性。 需要“商业情报报告工作”的工作百分比在几个月中波动,而“因果实验设计工作”的需求波动较小,但需求普遍较低。 由于我们数据收集过程中的技术错误,我们发现在June和July之间存在着差距,因此我们得出一个插值估计数。

blocks.en: When we trace the same work characteristics across months, the percentage of Data Analyst advertisements describing “reporting” falls and then rises again, and the percentage of Data Scientist advertisements describing “experiment design” also fluctuates. These patterns show that the emphasis of the collected descriptions varies across months, so a comparison of two selected months can look different when we examine the months in between.
blocks.zh: 当我们逐月追踪相同的工作特点时,描述“报告”的数据分析员广告的百分比会下降,然后再次上升,描述“实验设计”的数据科学家广告的百分比也会波动。 这些模式表明,所收集的描述的侧重点因月而异,因此,当我们审查两者之间的月份时,对两个选定的月份进行比较可能看起来不同。

blocks.en: We also observe changes in narrower parts of the work. Some Data Scientist comparisons differ in their emphasis on “preparing data” or “building data pipelines”, and Software Engineer comparisons differ in whether they mention “organizing data and presenting it visually”. These examples help describe the projects represented in a particular month, but the small and uneven monthly samples do not establish a consistent change across the wider job market.
blocks.zh: 我们还看到工作较窄部分的变化。 一些数据科学家的比较在强调“准备数据”或“建设数据管道”方面有所不同,而软件工程师的比较在是否提到“组织数据并视而不见”方面有所不同。 这些例子有助于描述特定月份的项目,但每月抽样数量少且不均衡,无法在整个就业市场形成一致的变化。

blocks.en: 5.7 Software Engineers Are Hired to Build Applications and Services
blocks.zh: 5.7 软件工程师受雇于建设应用程序和服务

blocks.en: Figure 18: A pair of horizontal bar charts comparing Software Engineer advertisements with Data Scientist advertisements above and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements below. Each bar represents the percentage of checked advertisements describing the given task or qualification. Software Engineer descriptions more often focus on building applications, and Data Scientist descriptions more often focus on developing “machine learning models” and communicating analytical findings. The lower panel shows that Machine Learning Engineer advertisements place more emphasis on developing and maintaining “machine learning models” and on the methods needed for that work.
blocks.zh: 图18:一对横向条形图将软件工程师广告与上面的数据科学家广告和下面的机器学习工程师广告进行比较. 每个栏目代表被检查的广告中说明特定任务或资格的百分比。 软件工程师的描述更注重建设应用,数据科学家的描述更注重开发"机器学习模型"和传达分析结论. 下级小组显示,机器学习工程师的广告更加强调发展和维持“机器学习模式”以及这项工作所需的方法。

blocks.en: Software Engineer advertisements more often describe building applications and software services, whereas Data Scientist advertisements more often describe developing “machine learning models” and explaining analytical findings. One software-engineering advertisement asks applicants to build Python services that give staff access to data and automate internal tasks. A Data Scientist advertisement instead asks for an executive presentation of an analysis, showing how the expected result can differ even when both roles use programming.
blocks.zh: 软件工程师的广告更经常地描述建筑应用和软件服务,而数据科学家的广告则更经常地描述开发"机器学习模型"和解释分析结论. 一项软件工程广告要求申请人建立Python服务,使工作人员能够获取数据并实现内部任务的自动化. 数据科学家的广告则要求执行人员提出分析,说明即使两个角色都使用编程,预期结果如何会有所不同。

blocks.en: The comparison with Machine Learning Engineer roles adds another distinction. Both roles involve software development, but the machine-learning descriptions more often focus on developing, training and evaluating “machine learning models”. Their qualifications also place more emphasis on “machine learning methods”, and Data Scientist qualifications more often name statistical methods and quantitative study backgrounds.
blocks.zh: 与机器学习工程师角色的比较增加了另一个区别. 这两种作用都涉及软件开发,但机器学习描述往往侧重于“机器学习模式”的开发、培训和评价。 他们的资历也更加强调“机器学习方法”,数据科学家的资历更经常地点名统计方法和定量研究背景。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: PERC and SAE provide different ways to inspect the same job postings. PERC groups descriptions so that GPT-6.1 Terra can explain differences in Team context, Role task and Qualifications. SAE finds patterns that can appear together within one posting, making it useful for examining combinations such as “developing machine learning models,” “reporting” and “deploying machine learning models”. The feature maps connect these views by showing which patterns activate within a selected PERC cluster.
blocks.zh: PERC和SAE为检查同一职位提供了不同的方式。 PERC分组描述,以便GPT-6.1 Terra能够解释团队背景,角色任务和资格方面的差异. SAE发现在一个职位中可以同时出现的模式,因此它有助于审查“发展机器学习模型”、“报告”和“部署机器学习模型”等组合。 特征图通过显示选定的PERC集群内哪些模式激活来连接这些视图.

blocks.en: The findings explain why jobs using the same tools can involve different work. A Data Scientist may develop “machine learning models” and explain their results, a Data Analyst may maintain the reports used to monitor a business, and a Software Engineer may build the application through which that work is used. Machine Learning Engineer advertisements put more emphasis on making “machine learning models” work within software, and Business Analyst advertisements can include building reports as well as defining what a business needs. Individual jobs can combine these activities, which is why we examine their descriptions alongside their titles.
blocks.zh: 调查结果解释了为什么使用相同工具的工作可以涉及不同的工作。 数据科学家可以开发“机器学习模型”并解释其成果,数据分析员可以保存用于监测企业的报告,软件工程师可以建立使用该工作的应用程序。 机器学习工程师的广告更加强调在软件内使“机器学习模式”发挥作用,商业分析员的广告可以包括编制报告以及确定业务需要。 个人工作可以将这些活动结合起来,因此,我们审查这些活动的描述和名称。

blocks.en: We compare what these workflows reveal from segmented job descriptions and where each method falls short. GPT-6 Luna also finds several of the broad occupational differences, so the results do not establish that SAE is generally better or that its findings are unique discoveries.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了这些工作流程从零碎的工作说明中揭示出来的内容,以及每种方法的缺点。 GPT-6 Luna也发现了几种广泛的职业差异,因此结果不能证明SAE一般较好或者其发现是独特的发现.

blocks.en: 6.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6.1 限制

blocks.en: The data primarily describe internships and cover employers and months unevenly. Repeated recruitment, formatting of the original descriptions and inaccurate occupation or passage labels can influence the groups. We do not have independent human judgments for every label or hypothesis. Checking a quotation confirms that it appears in the source advertisement, but does not establish that Terra interpreted it correctly.
blocks.zh: 这些数据主要介绍实习情况,涵盖雇主和月数不均匀。 重复招募,格式化原始描述以及不准确的职业或通道标签会影响群体. 我们并不对每一个标签或假设都有独立的人类判断。 检查引文证实其出现在来源广告中,但并未证实Terra解释正确.

blocks.en: The method comparison uses descriptions with similar formats and lengths from separate company sets, though some test postings appeared in earlier exploration. The seven segmentation text inputs contain different samples, so their ablations do not isolate the benefit of segmentation on a common set of full descriptions. Different language models and incomplete accounting of computational costs also prevent a general cost-quality ranking. Monthly samples are often small.
blocks.zh: 方法比较采用类似格式的描述和与单独公司套装的长度,尽管在早期的探索中出现了一些测试发布. 七段分解文字输入包含不同的样本,因此它们的分解不会在一组共同的完整描述上孤立分解的好处. 不同的语言模式和计算成本的不完全核算也阻碍了一般成本质量的排名. 每月样本往往很少。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: In this study, we examine how PERC and pretrained SAE analysis can help us understand the work described beneath job titles using 36,081 early-career job postings. By separating each description into Team context, Role task and Qualifications, we examine what applicants would do, which teams they would join and what backgrounds employers request. PERC groups descriptions with similar meaning and uses MMD to select differences for GPT-6.1 Terra to explain. Meanwhile, SAE analysis lets us examine features that can appear together within one description, with GPT-6 Luna generating hypotheses and GPT-6.1 Terra checking those claims against advertisements from held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 在这项研究中,我们研究了PERC和经过预先培训的SAE分析如何能够帮助我们理解职称下描述的工作,使用36 081个早期职业岗位。 通过将每个说明分为小组的背景、作用任务和资格,我们审查申请人将做什么工作、他们将加入哪些小组以及雇主要求什么背景。 PERC分组描述具有类似意义,并使用MMD为GPT-6.1 Terra选择差异来解释. 同时,SAE分析让我们审查一个描述中可以同时出现的特征,GPT-6 Luna生成假说和GPT-6.1 Terra对照被搁置公司的广告检查这些说法。

blocks.en: Across the five occupations, we observe differences that skill counts alone would not fully explain. Data Scientist advertisements place more emphasis on developing “machine learning models”, Data Analyst advertisements on reporting business performance, and Machine Learning Engineer advertisements on making “machine learning models” work within applications. Business Analyst descriptions connect business requirements with practical reporting work, and Software Engineer descriptions focus more on building applications and services. These responsibilities also overlap, which helps explain why two jobs requesting the same programming language can involve different work.
blocks.zh: 在五个职业中,我们看到差异,仅靠技能并不能充分解释。 数据科学家的广告更加强调开发“机器学习模型”,关于报告业务业绩的数据分析员广告,以及关于使“机器学习模型”在应用中发挥作用的机器学习工程师广告。 业务分析员描述将业务要求与实际报告工作联系起来,软件工程师描述更注重建设应用和服务. 这些职责也相互重叠,这有助于解释为什么两个工作要求相同的编程语言可以涉及不同的工作.

blocks.en: Our monthly comparisons further show differences in the projects being advertised. For example, the selected Data Scientist descriptions shift from infrastructure planning and reporting in February 2026 to remote sensing and agricultural analysis in September. Business Analyst descriptions similarly differ between operational reporting in April and consulting and scenario analysis in September. These findings describe changes within our collected advertisements, although uneven monthly coverage limits how far we can extend them to the wider job market. GPT-6 Luna also recovers several broad occupational differences through direct reading, so the additional value of SAE analysis depends on which characteristics we want to examine.
blocks.zh: 我们每月的比较进一步显示所公布的项目的差异。 例如,选定的数据科学家描述从2026年2月的基础设施规划和报告转向9月的遥感和农业分析。 业务分析员的描述在4月的业务报告与9月的咨询和情景分析之间也有类似差异。 这些调查结果描述了我们收集的广告中的变化,尽管每月的覆盖面不均衡,限制了我们将其扩展到更广泛的就业市场的程度。 GPT-6 Luna也通过直接读取恢复了几种广泛的职业差异,因此SAE分析的额外价值取决于我们要研究的特征.

blocks.en: For future work, we would first expand collection across consecutive months and include more full-time positions, since our current findings primarily describe internships. Following the same companies over time would also help us examine whether the work they advertise changes, rather than attributing differences entirely to a changing set of employers.
blocks.zh: 对于今后的工作,我们将首先在连续几个月中扩大收集工作,并包括更多的全职职位,因为我们目前的调查结果主要描述实习情况。 随着时间的推移,跟随同样的公司,还将有助于我们审查它们所宣传的工作是否发生了变化,而不是将差异完全归咎于不断变化的雇主。

blocks.en: After this, we would compare all seven segmentation text inputs using the same advertisements to examine whether separating Team context, Role task and Qualifications improves the insights obtained from complete descriptions. We would also compare PERC, SAE analysis and direct language-model reading under the same computational and API budget, with independent reviewers assessing whether the findings are supported by the descriptions and useful for understanding the roles. This would help establish when the additional feature analysis provides enough detail to justify its cost.
blocks.zh: 在此之后,我们将利用同样的广告来比较所有7个分区文本输入,以审查将团队背景、角色任务和资格区分开来是否改善了从完整描述中获得的见解。 我们还将在同样的计算和API预算下比较PERC、SAE分析和直接语言模型读取,与独立审查人员比较,评估结论是否得到说明的支持,是否有助于理解作用。 这将有助于确定何时额外特征分析提供了足够详细,以证明费用合理。

blocks.en: Appendix A Data and PERC Implementation
blocks.zh: 附录A 数据和执行情况

blocks.en: A.1 Data Collection and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: A.1 数据收集和预处理

blocks.en: We collect 41,040 records and retain 36,081 advertisements after checking their dates and text, removing duplicate advertisements posted on the same date, identifying company names and selecting early-career positions. These positions include internships, co-ops, junior and new-graduate roles, as well as descriptions requesting zero to two years of experience. Of the retained advertisements, 35,511 are internships and 570 are other early-career positions, which implies that the findings primarily describe internship recruitment.
blocks.zh: 我们收集了41,040份记录,并保留了36,081份广告,先检查其日期和文本,删除同日张贴的重复广告,确定公司名称,并选择早期职业职位。 这些职位包括实习、合作、初级和新研究生角色,以及要求提供0至2年经验的说明。 在保留广告中,35 511个是实习人员,570个是其他早期职业岗位,这意味着调查结果主要描述实习人员招聘。

blocks.en: Table 2: The number of job advertisements retained and removed during preprocessing. We report how many advertisements each preprocessing step removes and how many remain. When we select early-career positions, we remove 4,238 advertisements, which is the largest reduction, and retain 36,081 of the original 41,040 records. Empty descriptions account for 319 removed advertisements, and same-day deduplication removes another 276.
blocks.zh: 表2:预处理期间保留和删除的招聘广告数量. 我们报告每个预处理步骤移除的广告有多少,还有多少。 当我们选择早年职位时,我们删除了4,238个广告,这是减少最多的广告,保留了41,040个原始记录中的36,081个。 空描述占319个已删除的广告,同一天的调试又取消了276个.

blocks.en: To prepare the text, we remove HTML, normalize whitespace and exclude descriptions that contain only missing-value text, such as “nan.” We retain posting IDs containing letters or punctuation because these characters can be part of a valid identifier. We then remove duplicate advertisements with the same company, title, location, posting date and description. Advertisements posted on different dates remain separate observations at this stage.
blocks.zh: 为了准备文本,我们删除了HTML,使白空间正常化,并排除只包含缺失值文本的描述,如“nan”。 我们保留了包含字母或标点的ID,因为这些字符可以成为有效标识的一部分. 然后,我们删除同一公司的重复广告、标题、地点、张贴日期和说明。 在现阶段,在不同日期张贴的广告仍然是单独的观察。

blocks.en: We require a parsable posting date without applying a 90-day cutoff. The retained advertisements span 29 posting months from August 2023 to October 2026, although our scraper collected them between December 2025 and October 2026 with gaps in collection. The earlier posting dates belong to advertisements that were still available when the scraper retrieved them, so the dataset does not represent continuous collection throughout all 29 months.
blocks.zh: 我们需要一个可解析的张贴日期,而不适用90天的截止日期。 保留广告从2023年8月至2026年10月长达29个张贴月,尽管我们的刮刮机在2025年12月至2026年10月期间收集了这些广告,但收集工作有缺口。 更早的张贴日期属于刮刮机检索时仍可提供的广告,因此数据集并不代表整个29个月的持续收集.

blocks.en: We retain all job types during preprocessing and then classify occupations from job titles and advertised-role descriptions for the occupation comparisons. This gives 901 Machine Learning Engineer, 3,121 Data Scientist, 3,840 Data Analyst, 474 Business Analyst and 906 Software Engineer advertisements. Another 165 advertisements describe joint titles and 26,674 describe other or unspecified occupations, so we include them in the overall analysis without assigning them to one of the five occupation comparisons.
blocks.zh: 在预先处理期间,我们保留所有类型的工作,然后将职业从职称中分类,并公布职业比较的作用说明。 这给了901名机器学习工程师,3,121名数据科学家,3,840名 数据分析员,474个业务分析员和906个软件工程师广告. 另有165个广告描述了联合标题,26 674个广告描述了其他或未指明的职业,因此,我们将这些职业纳入总体分析,而不将它们归入五个职业比较中。

blocks.en: A.2 Text Sections and Input Combinations
blocks.zh: A.2 文本部分和输入组合

blocks.en: A job description can discuss the team, the work and the applicant’s background within the same paragraph. To examine these separately, we first divide the description into short passages and use GPT-6 Luna to classify each passage using the surrounding text for context. We retain passages labeled as Team context, Role task or Qualifications and exclude company promotion, employment terms, boilerplate and uncertain content.
blocks.zh: 职务说明可以在同一段内讨论团队,工作和申请人的背景. 为了分别审查这些内容,我们首先将描述分为短段,并使用GPT-6 Luna来利用周围的文字对每个段落进行上下文分类. 我们保留了标注为团队背景、角色任务或资格的段落,不包括公司晋升、就业条件、锅炉板和不确定内容。

blocks.en: When a passage mixes retained content with excluded material, GPT-6 Luna marks the boundaries using exact prefixes from the source text. We use these boundaries to retain the original text spans without paraphrasing. A passage containing more than one retained category receives the best-fitting label. Finally, we group the retained passages by their labels to form the three sections.
blocks.zh: 当一段将保留的内容与排除的材料混合时,GPT-6 Luna使用源文本中准确的前缀标记边界. 我们使用这些边界来保留原文的跨度,而不作解释。 包含一个以上保留类别的段落获得最合适的标签。 最后,我们将保留段落按其标签分类,形成三个部分。

We refer to the final combination as the full retained description because it contains all three selected sections. The original advertisement can also contain application instructions, benefits and company promotion, which are outside those sections.

blocks.en: A.3 Split Dataset by Company Names
blocks.zh: A.3 按公司名称划分数据集

blocks.en: We randomly assign 60% of normalized company names to training, 20% to validation and 20% to testing using seed 42. All advertisements from one company name remain in the same set, so repeated employer wording cannot appear in both training and validation through that company. We mix months and occupations within the sets, obtaining 3,643 training companies, 1,214 validation companies and 1,214 test companies, containing 21,871, 7,524 and 6,686 advertisements respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们随机分配60%的正规公司名称用于培训,20%用于验证,20%用于使用42种种子进行测试。 一个公司名称的所有广告都保持不变,因此,雇主的反复措辞不能通过该公司在培训和验证中出现。 我们把月份和职业混在一起,获得了3 643个培训公司、1 214个验证公司和1 214个测试公司,分别载有21 871个、7 524个和6 686个广告。

blocks.en: We fit dimensionality reduction and clustering on the training advertisements, select the PERC configuration using validation advertisements and evaluate the selected configuration once on test advertisements. This lets us examine whether clusters fitted to descriptions from one set of employers also group descriptions from held-out employers. We do not train the framework to predict the occupation labels.
blocks.zh: 我们适合降低维度,在培训广告上进行分组,利用验证广告选择PERC配置,并在测试广告上评价选定的配置。 这让我们来审查是否与一组雇主的描述相适应的集群以及被搁置雇主的集群描述。 我们不训练框架来预测占领标签。

blocks.en: Within each segmentation text input and set, identical joined text counts once per company. Every distinct training text has equal weight, so a company with more distinct descriptions contributes more observations. When measuring word separation, we instead select one advertisement per company using a reproducible sample. The number of test advertisements therefore depends on which sections are available and which duplicate descriptions have been removed.
blocks.zh: 在每次分区文本输入和设定中,每个公司一次相同的合并文本计数. 每个不同的培训文本都有同等的份量,因此,一个描述更为鲜明的公司会贡献更多的观察. 在衡量字词分离时,我们选择每个公司使用可复制样本的广告. 因此,测试广告的数量取决于哪些章节可供使用,哪些重复描述已被删除。

blocks.en: After evaluating the framework, we use all job advertisements retained after preprocessing for the monthly and occupation analyses, with equal weight for each advertisement in MMD. These analyses are therefore not restricted to the 20% of company names reserved for testing.
blocks.zh: 在对框架进行评估后,我们利用预先处理后保留的所有工作广告进行月度和职业分析,对小额供资和微型企业部的每个广告都给予同等的分量。 因此,这些分析并不限于保留用于测试的公司名称的20%。

blocks.en: A.4 Semantic Representation
blocks.zh: A.4 语义代表

blocks.en: To represent the selected text, we embed each advertisement into one vector per available segmentation text input. We compare MiniLM-L6, MPNet-base, BGE-base-en-v1.5, E5-base-v2, EmbeddingGemma 2 and text-embedding-3-small. These embedding models let us compare compact sentence embeddings, retrieval embeddings and embedding models that accept longer descriptions under the inference settings listed below.
blocks.zh: 为了代表选定的文本,我们将每个广告嵌入每个可用的分区文本输入的矢量。 我们比较了MiniLM-L6,MPNet-base,BGE-base-en-v1.5,E5-base-v2,EmbeddingGemma 2和文本嵌入-3-small. 这些嵌入模型让我们比较紧凑的句子嵌入,检索嵌入和嵌入模型,这些模型接受以下所列推论设置下更长的描述.

blocks.en: Table 3: The settings used to turn job-ad text into vectors with six embedding models. Each row represents one embedding model, and the columns give its name, the number of values in its output vector, its maximum input tokens and its numerical precision during local inference. API output means that internal precision is unspecified, and we store those vectors as float32. MiniLM produces the shortest vectors at 384 dimensions and text-embedding-3-small the longest at 1,536, whereas EmbeddingGemma 2 and text-embedding-3-small accept much longer inputs than the four remaining embedding models.
blocks.zh: 表3:用于将工作ad文本转换成有六个嵌入模型的向量的设置. 每行代表一个嵌入模型,列给出其名称,输出矢量中的值数,最大输入符以及局部推论时的数值精度. API输出表示内部精度不明,我们将这些矢量存储为浮点32. MiniLM产生384维的最短向量,文本嵌入-3-小,最长为1,536,而EmbeddingGemma 2和文本嵌入-3-小接受比其余四个嵌入模型更长的输入.

blocks.en: When a description exceeds the embedding model’s input limit, we divide it into chunks and embed each chunk separately. We normalize the chunk vectors, average them with weights proportional to their token counts and normalize the resulting vector. For E5, we add the prefix query: , and for Gemma we add task: clustering | query: . The local chunk lengths leave room for these prefixes and the embedding model’s special tokens.
blocks.zh: 当一个描述超过嵌入模型的输入限制时, 我们把它分成块并分别嵌入每个块 。 我们使块矢量正常化,平均重量与它们的象征数成正比,使由此产生的矢量正常化。 对于E5,我们添加前缀查询: ,对于Gemma,我们添加任务:集群QQ查询: . 本地块长度为这些前缀和嵌入模型的特殊标志留下了空间 。

blocks.en: Of the 19,329 advertisements containing all three sections, 65.6% exceed MiniLM’s input limit, 43.0% exceed MPNet’s, 22.0% exceed BGE’s and 22.2% exceed E5’s. Every description fits within the limits of EmbeddingGemma 2 and text-embedding-3-small. Consequently, the embedding model comparison also reflects differences in input length and the use of chunk averaging.
blocks.zh: 在包含所有三个部分的19 329个广告中,65.6%超过Minilm的输入限制,43.0%超过MPNet,22.0%超过BGE,22.2%超过E5。 每个描述都符合EmbeddingGemma 2和文本嵌入-3-小的极限. 因此,嵌入模型比较也反映了输入长度和使用平均块的不同。

blocks.en: A.5 Dimensionality Reduction and Clustering
blocks.zh: A.5 减少规模和集群

blocks.en: For each embedding model, we compare the original vectors with PCA and UMAP at 10 and 50 components. We then apply K-means, diagonal Gaussian mixtures, hierarchical agglomerative clustering with Ward linkage and spectral clustering using four, six or eight clusters. We also test six HDBSCAN configurations, combining EOM or leaf selection with minimum cluster sizes of 10, 15 or 30 and a minimum of five samples. These methods group descriptions using cluster centers, Gaussian distributions, hierarchical distances, neighbor connections or local density [16] , [17] .
blocks.zh: 对于每个嵌入模型,我们在10和50个组件上将原始矢量与PCA和UMAP进行比较. 然后,我们应用K-分子、对角高斯混合物、带有沃德连线的分层群和利用四、六或八组的光谱群。 我们还测试了6个HDBSCAN配置,结合EOM或叶片选择,最小组群大小为10,15或30,最小样本为5个. 这些方法使用集群中心,高斯分布,等级距离,邻接或局部密度[16],[17]进行分组描述.

blocks.en: PCA uses full singular-value decomposition without whitening. UMAP uses 30 neighbors, a minimum distance of zero and cosine distance, with the same seed for fitting and transformation. K-means uses ten initializations. This produces 540 configurations per segmentation text input and 3,780 configurations across all seven inputs. Repeating the evaluation with seeds 42, 7, 19, 73 and 101 gives 18,900 records. We reuse repeated records for hierarchical agglomerative clustering and HDBSCAN when the original or PCA vectors are unchanged because those fits are deterministic. The selected framework must include dimensionality reduction, so the selection itself does not establish that reduction is necessary.
blocks.zh: 五氯苯甲醚使用全单值分解而不白化. UMAP使用30个邻居,最小距离为0和余弦距离,种子相同,用于配制和转化. K指使用十个初始化. 这产生了540个配置,每个分区文本输入,以及3,780个配置,覆盖所有7个输入. 重复以种子42,7,19,73和101进行评价,获得18,900个记录. 当原有或五氯苯甲醚的矢量保持不变时,我们再用重复的记录来进行分级聚合和HDBSCAN,因为这些矢量是决定性的。 选定的框架必须包括减少维度,因此选择本身并不确定减少的必要性。

blocks.en: For hierarchical agglomerative clustering and spectral clustering, we construct a symmetric graph from the 30 nearest training neighbors. Neither method directly assigns a newly arriving advertisement to a fitted cluster, so we use a distance-weighted vote from its five nearest training neighbors in the selected representation. For spectral clustering, LOBPCG uses a tolerance of 0.00001 and seed 42, and we vary the seed of its K-means step. Gaussian mixtures use diagonal covariance, float64 fitting and three initializations. We check convergence and exclude numerical fits that fail.
blocks.zh: 对于分级集聚和光谱集聚,我们从30个最近的训练邻居中构建一个对称图. 这两种方法都不直接将新到的广告指定给一个合适的集群,所以我们使用一个距离加权的选票,从它所选代表的五个最近的训练邻居那里得到。 对于光谱集成,LOBPCG使用0.00001的耐受度和42种子,我们改变它的K-表示步骤的种子. 高斯混合物采用对角共变,浮64装配和三个初始化. 我们检查趋同度,排除数字符合失败。

blocks.en: To compare configurations, we measure assignment agreement across seeds using Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) and separation in the original embedding space using cosine silhouette on up to 1,000 validation texts. For K-means, Gaussian mixtures, hierarchical agglomerative clustering and spectral clustering, we calculate these scores before rejecting distant advertisements. For HDBSCAN, ARI includes the unassigned label and silhouette excludes unassigned advertisements.
blocks.zh: 为了比较配置,我们使用调整后的Rand指数(ARI)测量种子之间的分配协议,并利用最多1,000份验证文本在原嵌入空间中进行分离。 高斯混合物、分层聚落和光谱聚落 我们先计算这些分数 然后再拒绝遥远的广告 对HDBSCAN来说,ARI包括未指定的标签和未指定的广告。

blocks.en: We also measure word separation using TF-IDF cosine silhouette on one reproducibly selected advertisement per validation company, giving each cluster equal weight in the final score. The vocabulary and inverse document frequencies are fitted on training text only, excluding common career wording. This measures whether the clusters differ in their word use as well as their embedding vectors.
blocks.zh: 我们还利用TF-IDF的宇宙硅光谱测量每个验证公司一个可重选的广告的字词分离,在最终得分中给予每个集群同等的分量. 词汇和反向文件频率仅与培训文本相匹配,不包括共同的职业措辞。 以此衡量集群在词的使用及其嵌入矢量上是否不同.

blocks.en: Under the criteria for selecting the right PERC framework configuration, we require a positive word-separation score, a mean ARI of at least 0.60 and cluster assignments for at least 60% of validation texts. Each cluster must contain at least ten training companies, five validation companies and ten validation advertisements, and no training company can account for more than 20% of that cluster. We then select the eligible configuration with the highest word-separation score, so a high score alone is insufficient when a cluster largely repeats one employer’s descriptions.
blocks.zh: 根据选择正确的 PERC 框架配置的标准,我们需要一个正面的单词分隔分数,一个至少0.60的中间 ARI 和至少60%的验证文本的分组任务. 每个集群必须包含至少10个培训公司,5个验证公司和10个验证广告,任何培训公司都不得超过该集群的20%. 因此,如果一个集群基本上重复一个雇主的描述,单靠高分是不够的。

blocks.en: For K-means, we reject assignments beyond the cluster’s 95th percentile of training distances. For every method, we also reject advertisements below the cluster’s fifth percentile of training cosine similarity in the original embedding space. These advertisements remain available for comparisons of the overall distributions. After selection, we evaluate the seed-42 framework on test companies without changing its configuration in response to those results.
blocks.zh: 我们拒绝超过95%训练距离的任务。 对于每一种方法,我们也拒绝在原嵌入空间中低于培训余弦的五分之一的广告。 这些广告仍可供比较总发行量。 经过挑选,我们评价试验公司42号种子框架,但不因这些结果而改变其配置。

blocks.en: A.7 Cluster Selection and Narrative Analysis
blocks.zh: A.7 分组选择和叙述分析

blocks.en: For each occupation and segmentation text input, we calculate MMD between eligible months within the same cluster. We retain the month pair with the largest MMD for each cluster and then select up to three distinct clusters. Meanwhile, to compare different clusters, we calculate MMD between cluster pairs within the same month, retain the largest month-specific difference for each pair and select up to three pairs.
blocks.zh: 对于每个职业和分区文字输入,我们计算同一组内合格月份之间的MMD. 我们保留每个集群的最大MMD的月对,然后选择最多三个不同的集群. 同时,为了比较不同的集群,我们在同一个月内计算集群配对之间的MMD,保留每个配对的最大月份特定差,并选择最多3对.

blocks.en: Each side of a comparison must contain at least 30 advertisements and five recorded company names. We count the company names available in the dataset, which can still include employer aliases or publishing services. The occupation comparisons use the clusters fitted across all job types for that segmentation text input, so we do not fit a new clustering framework for each occupation.
blocks.zh: 比较的两边必须至少包含30个广告和5个录制的公司名称. 我们计算数据集中现有的公司名称,其中仍然可以包括雇主的别名或出版服务。 职业比较利用所有职类的分组来进行分类文字输入,因此,我们不适合每个职业的新的分组框架。

blocks.en: After selecting the comparisons, we give GPT-6.1 Terra every original job description from the two selected groups, together with the passages used for clustering. We label each advertisement with its occupation, cluster, posting month, company and posting ID so Terra can identify which group it belongs to. We send each comparison in one request without sampling advertisements or dividing the clusters into batches, and ask for differences and similarities in Team context, Role task and Qualifications.
blocks.zh: 在选择比较后,我们给出了GPT-6.1 Terra从两个选定的组中每一个原始的工作描述,以及用于集群的段落. 贴上每个广告的标签, 我们每一份比较都发出一份请求,不提供广告样本,也不将各组分成批,并询问小组的背景、任务和资格等方面的差异和相似之处。

blocks.en: For each finding, GPT-6.1 Terra must quote an advertisement from each group. We check these quotations and their cluster membership against the source descriptions. Across 81 responses, three quotations and three inline source IDs required corrections in five responses, and we retain both the original and corrected versions. These checks confirm where a statement comes from, although they do not measure how common it is across the cluster. Two additional comparisons exceed GPT-6.1 Terra’s context limit and remain unrun.
blocks.zh: 对于每个发现,GPT-6.1 Terra必须引用每个组的广告. 我们对照来源的描述来检查这些引文及其分组成员。 在81份答复中,有3份引文和3份内在源代码需要5份答复的更正,我们保留了原文和更正本。 这些检查确认一个陈述来自何处,尽管它们并不衡量整个集群的常见程度。 另有两项比较超过了GPT-6.1Terra的上下文限制,仍未运行。

blocks.en: B.1 Selected Configurations and Held-Out Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.1 选定的配置和即时评价

blocks.en: Across the seven configuration searches, we record 18,900 results covering five random seeds, with no numerical fit failures. Of the 3,780 configurations, 542 meet the criteria for selecting the right PERC framework configuration, with 54 to 102 eligible configurations per segmentation text input. We exclude the original-vector configurations from selection because the selected framework is required to use dimensionality reduction. Table 4 lists the highest-ranked eligible configuration for each input.
blocks.zh: 在7个配置搜索中,我们记录了18,900个结果,覆盖了5个随机种子,没有数字匹配失败. 在3,780个配置中,542个符合选择正确的PERC框架配置的标准,每个分区文本输入54到102个符合条件的配置. 我们把原始的-矢量配置排除在选择之外,因为所选择的框架是使用维度减小的要求. 表4列出了每项投入排名最高的合格配置.

blocks.en: Table 4: This table demonstrates the selected PERC configurations for the seven segmentation text inputs. Each row represents one input, and the columns give its section combination, embedding model, reduction method and clustering setting. The number after PCA or UMAP represents the reduced vector dimension, and the number in parentheses represents the number of clusters. Five inputs use PCA and two use UMAP, with hierarchical agglomerative clustering selected for four inputs. The full retained job description joins Team context, Role task and Qualifications.
blocks.zh: 表 4: 本表显示七个分区文本输入所选的 PERC 配置. 每行代表一个输入,列给出其段组合,嵌入模型,还原方法和集群设置. PCA或UMAP之后的数字代表减少的矢量维度,括号中的数字代表集群数. 5种投入使用PCA,2种使用UMAP,分级加成组选择4种投入. 保留的全部职务说明加入了小组的背景、角色任务和资格。

blocks.en: We select PCA for five inputs and UMAP for two, together with hierarchical agglomerative clustering for four inputs, K-means for two and spectral clustering for one. MPNet, MiniLM and text-embedding-3-small are each selected for two inputs, and BGE is selected for the remaining input. E5 and Gemma also produce eligible configurations but do not obtain the highest eligible score for any input.
blocks.zh: 我们为5个输入选择了五氯苯甲醚,为2个选择了UMAP,同时为4个输入选择了分级群集,为2个选择了K-表示,为1个选择了光谱群集。 MPNet,MiniLM和文本嵌入-3-small各选两个输入,BGE选其余输入. E5和Gemma也生产符合条件的配置,但没有获得任何输入的最高合格分.

blocks.en: Table 5: The validation measurements for the selected PERC configurations, where each row represents one segmentation text input. The columns give the input, Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) across repeated runs, the percentage of advertisements assigned to a cluster, TF-IDF cosine silhouette as Word separation, and silhouette in the original embeddings as Vector silhouette. Role task + Qualifications has the highest word separation at 0.0641, and Team context + Role task has the highest vector silhouette at 0.0906, so the strongest separation depends on which representation we measure. blocks.en: The four selected hierarchical agglomerative configurations have an ARI of one because PCA and the clustering algorithm repeat the same assignments on unchanged data. For spectral clustering, agreement across seeds reflects its K-means step on unchanged graph coordinates. Role task has the lowest selected ARI at 0.7806. These scores describe sensitivity to random initialization on the same sample, so we also evaluate the selected configurations on advertisements from held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 由于PCA和集群算法在未改变的数据上重复了相同的任务,所选择的4个等级加成配置有一个ARI. 对于光谱集群,跨种子协议反映了其在不变的图表坐标上的K-表示步骤. 角色任务选取的ARI最低,为0.7806. 这些分数描述了在同一样本上随机初始化的敏感性,因此我们也评价被搁置公司广告上的选定配置.

blocks.en: The original-vector silhouettes range from 0.0143 to 0.0906 and the word-separation scores are also small, indicating substantial overlap between the descriptions. The clusters therefore help us organize related advertisements for reading, although the measurements do not establish sharply separated professions.
