blocks.en: Table 6: The selected PERC configurations evaluated on advertisements from held-out companies, where each row represents one segmentation text input. Test ads counts distinct job-description texts separately for each company, Test companies counts company names, Assigned gives the percentage of advertisements assigned to a cluster, and Word separation is TF-IDF cosine silhouette. Between 91.2% and 94.9% of these advertisements receive cluster assignments, and Role task + Qualifications has the highest word-separation score at 0.0765. Thus, this input also produces the strongest separation in word use among the selected configurations on held-out companies.
blocks.zh: 表6:在被搁置公司广告上评价的选定PERC配置,每行代表一个分区文本输入. 测试广告对每个公司分别计算不同的职务说明文本,测试公司计算公司名称,指定给一个集群的广告百分比,Word分离为TF-IDFcosine silhouette. 其中91.2%至94.9%的广告获得集群任务,角色任务+资格评分最高的单词分数为0.0765. 因此,这种投入还使被搁置公司的选定配置在文字使用上实现最强的分离。

blocks.en: On the test companies, 91.2% to 94.9% of advertisements receive cluster assignments and every input has positive word separation. However, Team context + Role task falls from 0.0116 on validation companies to 0.0061 on test companies despite near-perfect agreement across seeds. This shows why repeating assignments on the same data and separating descriptions from held-out companies are different aspects of the evaluation. Neither measurement represents accuracy in predicting occupation labels.
blocks.zh: 在测试公司,91.2%至94.9%的广告获得集群任务,每一份投入都有正字分离. 然而,小组的背景+ 角色任务从关于验证公司的0.0116降至关于试验公司的0.061,尽管种子之间几乎达成了完美协议。 这表明为什么重复同一数据的任务和将描述与被搁置的公司分开是评价的不同方面。 这两种衡量方法都代表了预测职业标签的准确性。

blocks.en: B.2 How Embedding, Reduction and Clustering Affect the Results
blocks.zh: B.2 嵌入、减少和集群如何影响成果

blocks.en: To examine the effect of the embedding model, we first use PCA with ten components and K-means with four clusters for every embedding model. Under this configuration, MiniLM has the highest Role task word-separation score at 0.0056 and text-embedding-3-small scores near zero. After searching the reduction and clustering configurations for each embedding model, text-embedding-3-small reaches 0.0443 with UMAP at 50 dimensions and becomes the selected Role task embedding model, compared with MiniLM’s best eligible score of 0.0104. The embedding model ranking therefore changes when we configure the later stages separately for each embedding model.
blocks.zh: 为了检查嵌入模型的效果,我们首先使用具有10个组件的PCA和每个嵌入模型有四个组的K-表示. 在这种配置下,MiniLM在"角色任务"单词分离得分最高,为0.0056,文本嵌入-3-小分数接近零. 在搜索了每个嵌入模型的减少和集群配置后,文本嵌入-3-小在50维的UMAP下达到0.0443,成为选定的角色任务嵌入模型,与MiniLM的最佳合格分数0.0104相比. 因此,当我们为每个嵌入模型分别配置后期时,嵌入模型的排名就会发生变化。

blocks.en: Figure 20: A series of dot plots comparing six embedding models under PCA at 10 dimensions and four K-means clusters. Panels A, B and C report agreement across runs, the percentage of advertisements assigned to clusters and TF-IDF cosine silhouette. Panel C shows MiniLM leading on Role task at 0.0056, whereas the other embedding models score near zero or below. For Qualifications, text-embedding-3-small leads at 0.0144 and E5 scores lowest at 0.0066. Team context scores remain close to zero for every embedding model. Panels A and B show generally high agreement across runs and assignment rates around 90%–94%, so these measures vary less than the separation of word use in panel C.
blocks.zh: 图20:一系列点图,比较PCA下10维的6个嵌入模型和4个K-分子群. 小组 A,B和C报告协议贯穿全局,分配给集群和TF-IDF的广告比例. 小组讨论会 C显示MiniLM在角色任务上领先于0.0056,而其他嵌入模型得分接近或低于零. 对于资格赛,文字-嵌入-3-小成绩为0.0144,E5得分最低的成绩为0.0066. 每个嵌入模型的团队上下文分数仍然接近零. 小组 A和B普遍表现出高度一致,分配率约为90-%-94%,因此这些措施的差别小于小组C的字词使用分离。

blocks.en: Figure 21: A comparison of the best eligible configuration for each embedding model and text input, presented as three dot plots. Panels A, B and C report agreement across runs, the percentage of advertisements assigned to clusters and TF-IDF cosine silhouette. Text-embedding-3-small leads on Role task at 0.0443, followed by BGE at 0.0355, whereas MiniLM reaches 0.0104. BGE produces the largest score in the figure at 0.0641 for Qualifications + Role task. MPNet leads on Team context and Team context + Role task, whereas MiniLM narrowly leads when all three sections are joined. The different winners show that the strongest separation depends on the text input and its accompanying reduction and clustering methods.
blocks.zh: 图21:每个嵌入模型和文本输入的最佳合格配置比较,以三个点块显示. 小组 A,B和C报告协议贯穿全局,分配给集群和TF-IDF的广告比例. 0.0443为角色任务的文本嵌入-3-小线索,随后BGE为0.0355,而MiniLM则达到0.0104. BGE在"资格+角色任务"中以0.0641的成绩产生最大分数. MPNet在Team上下文和Team上下文+角色任务上领头,而MinelM则在三部分都加入时狭义地领头. 不同的获奖者表明,最强的分离取决于文本输入及其伴随的减少和分组方法.

blocks.en: For all three joined sections, Gemma reaches a best eligible word-separation score of 0.0120 compared with MiniLM’s 0.0124. Although Gemma accepts the complete descriptions without chunking, this longer input limit does not give it the highest score in this comparison. These measurements describe the resulting clusters and do not establish how much information each embedding model preserves from every description.
blocks.zh: 对于所有三个加盟区,Gemma与MiniLM的0.0124. 虽然Gemma接受完整的描述而不进行块化,但是这个较长的输入限制并没有给予它这个比较中的最高分数. 这些测量方法描述了由此产生的集群,没有确定每个嵌入模型从每个描述中保存多少信息.

blocks.en: To examine dimensionality reduction, we use MPNet and four K-means clusters throughout the comparison. For Team context, word separation increases from near zero with PCA at ten dimensions to 0.0041 with UMAP at 50 dimensions. For all three joined sections, the direction reverses, with PCA at ten dimensions scoring 0.0087 and UMAP at 50 dimensions scoring 0.0077. Thus, the reduction method that gives greater separation depends on which parts of the advertisement we embed.
blocks.zh: 为了审查维度的降低,我们在整个比较过程中使用MPNet和四个K-手段集群. 对于Team语境,词分离从10维的PA的近零增加到50维的0.041的UMAP. 对于所有三个结合部分,方向反转,PAC在10维积分0.0087,UMAP在50维积分0.0077. 因此,给予更大分离的减少方法取决于我们嵌入的广告的哪些部分.

blocks.en: Figure 22: A three-panel dot plot comparison of the original MPNet vectors, PCA and UMAP under four K-means clusters. Panel A shows agreement across runs, B shows the percentage of advertisements assigned to clusters and C shows TF-IDF cosine silhouette. Panel C shows the largest increases in TF-IDF cosine silhouette with UMAP for Role task, Qualifications and their combination, which reaches about 0.0567 compared with about 0.0085 for PCA or the original vectors. Increasing UMAP from 10 to 50 dimensions adds little. Joining all three sections reverses the ranking slightly, with PCA near 0.0086 and UMAP near 0.0077. Panel A also shows lower agreement for UMAP on Team context + Role task, and panel B shows that these increases in cosine silhouette do not consistently increase the percentage of advertisements assigned to clusters.
blocks.zh: 图22:在四个K-分子群下,对最初的MPNet向量,PCA和UMAP进行三层点图比较. 小组讨论会 A显示协议横行,B显示分配给集群的广告百分比,C显示TF-IDF的cosiine silhouette. 小组讨论会 C显示TF-IDF中带有UMAP作用任务,资质及其组合的共聚硅酸酯的增量最大,达到约0.0567,而PCA或原始矢量的增量约为0.0085. 将UMAP从10个维度增加到50个维度,增加的很少。 加入所有三个部分会稍微扭转排名,PCA接近0.0086,UMAP接近0.0077. 小组讨论会 A还显示UMAP对于Team上下文+角色任务的约定较低,B面板显示这些余弦硅胶的增量并不能持续增加分配给集群的广告比例.

blocks.en: We also check whether a high word-separation score comes from advertisements across several companies. For example, MPNet with UMAP at 50 dimensions and four clusters scores 0.0405 on Role task, but one company accounts for 26.1% of a training cluster, exceeding our 20% limit. We therefore exclude this configuration from selection even though its plotted score is high.
blocks.zh: 也检查几家公司的广告中是否有高分字分。 例如,具有50维的UMAP的MPNet和四个集群在角色任务上得分为0.0405,但一家公司占培训集群的26.1%,超过了我们20%的极限. 因此,我们不选择这种配置,尽管其图谋得分很高。

blocks.en: Finally, we compare clustering methods using MPNet and PCA at 50 dimensions, showing the highest word-separation score among the tested configurations for each method. The complete search selects hierarchical agglomerative clustering, K-means and spectral clustering, and retains Gaussian mixtures and HDBSCAN as comparison methods. These results apply to the cluster counts, neighbor graphs, assignment procedures and company requirements tested here.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们用 MPNet 和 PCPA 在50 维度上比较组合方法, 显示每种方法的测试配置中文字分离分数最高。 完整的搜索选择了分级的星系聚,K-分子和光谱聚,并保留高斯混合物和HDBSCAN作为比较方法. 这些结果适用于在此测试的集群计数、邻图、分配程序和公司要求。

blocks.en: Figure 23: A three-panel comparison of clustering methods presented as dot plots using MPNet and 50-dimensional PCA. Panels A, B and C report agreement across runs, the percentage of advertisements assigned to clusters and TF-IDF cosine silhouette. Each point shows that method’s highest-scoring tested configuration. HDBSCAN reaches a Team context silhouette of 0.126 but assigns only 11.9% of advertisements. Spectral clustering separates task and qualification wording more strongly than K-means or hierarchical agglomerative clustering and assigns about 93% of advertisements. Gaussian mixtures have the lowest agreement across runs at ARI 0.48–0.69.
blocks.zh: 图23:使用MPNet和50维五氯苯甲醚作为点地块列报的组合方法的三组比较。 小组 A,B和C报告协议贯穿全局,分配给集群和TF-IDF的广告比例. 每个点都显示该方法测试得分最高的配置. HDBSCAN达到0.126的Team上下文遮挡,但只分配了11.9%的广告. 光谱类集比K类集或分级类集更能区分任务和资格措辞,并分配了大约93%的广告。 高斯混合物的一致度最低,为0.48-0.69。

blocks.en: Together, the ablations show that text selection, embedding, reduction and clustering affect one another. A higher word-separation score measures more distinct word use, although it does not directly measure whether the resulting interpretation is useful. The seven segmentation text inputs also contain different advertisements because their section requirements differ. In the separate comparison of PERC, SAE and text-only inputs, we use the same advertisements for all three conditions, but we do not compare all seven segmentation inputs on one common sample.
blocks.zh: 拼贴图表明,文本选择、嵌入、减少和集群相互影响。 较高的单词分隔分数度量比较鲜明的单词用法,虽然它并不直接度量由此产生的解释是否有用. 7个区块文字输入中也包含不同的广告,因为它们的区块要求不同. 在PERC,SAE和仅文本输入的单独比较中,我们对所有三个条件都使用相同的广告,但是我们并不比较一个共同样本上的所有七个分区输入.

blocks.en: Appendix C Complete-Cluster Case Studies
blocks.zh: 附录C 个案研究

blocks.en: C.1 Comparing the Selected Clusters
blocks.zh: C.1 比较选定的集群

blocks.en: We apply the seven selected PERC configurations in Table 4 to the monthly and occupation analyses, calculating MMD from the original embedding vectors and using the fitted clusters to organize the descriptions. GPT-6.1 Terra reads 81 comparisons, including 49 comparisons of the same cluster across months and 32 comparisons of different clusters within one month. Of these, 80 describe Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Machine Learning Engineer or Business Analyst advertisements and one combines all occupations. Table 7 gives the counts for each occupation.
blocks.zh: 我们把表4中选定的七个PERC配置用于月度和职业分析,从原始嵌入载体中计算MMD,并利用安装的集群来组织描述. GPT-6.1 Terra读取了81个比较,包括同一组数月的49个比较和1个月内不同组数的32个比较. 其中,80个描述数据科学家,数据分析师,机器学习工程师或商业分析师广告,一个描述将所有职业结合起来. 表7列出了每项职业的计数。

blocks.en: Figure 24: A set of MMD matrices comparing monthly Role task vector distributions within each occupation. Darker cells indicate larger MMD scores and blank cells mark months with fewer than 30 advertisements. The darker bands in the Machine Learning Engineer and Data Scientist panels separate August–November 2025 descriptions from later descriptions, whereas Data Analyst also shows a strong contrast between July 2025 and later months. The largest displayed difference occurs in Business Analyst between November 2025 and March 2026, with MMD 0.230. Business Analyst has far fewer available month pairs than the other occupations.
blocks.zh: 图24:一套MMD矩阵比较每个职业内每月的角色任务矢量分布. 更暗的细胞表示更大的MMD分数和空白的细胞标记月,广告少于30个. 机器学习工程师和数据科学家小组中较黑暗的波段将2025年8月至11月的描述与后来的描述分开,而数据分析师也显示出2025年7月和以后几个月之间的强烈对比。 最大的显示差异发生在2025年11月至2026年3月期间的业务分析师,MMD 0.230. 与其他职业相比,业务分析员的月配对要少得多。

blocks.en: Table 7: The completed GPT-6.1 Terra cluster comparisons by occupation. For each occupation and the combined sample, we count comparisons across months within the same cluster and comparisons between clusters within the same month. The final row sums these counts, giving 49 monthly and 32 same-month comparisons. Data Scientist and Data Analyst advertisements account for 63 of the 81 comparisons, so most of these analyses of all advertisements in the selected groups describe work within those two occupations.
blocks.zh: 表7:按职业分列的完成的GPT-6.1Terra群比较。 对于每个职业和合并样本,我们计算同一组内几个月的比较和同一月内各组的比较。 最后一行是计算数,每月49个,同月32个。 在81个比较中,数据科学家和数据分析员的广告占63个,因此,这些对选定小组中所有广告的分析大多都描述了这两个职业内的工作。

blocks.en: Across these comparisons, GPT-6.1 Terra produces 347 findings with source quotations at a recorded token cost of $21.52. Some findings recur across segmentation text inputs, so the total does not represent 347 independent discoveries. The completed all-occupation comparison uses Team context + Role task. The additional comparisons using Team context + Qualifications and all three sections exceed the context limit and remain unrun.
blocks.zh: 通过这些比较,GPT-6.1 Terra得出了347项调查结果和来源报价,记录的象征性费用为21.52美元。 一些结论在分块文字输入中反复出现,因此总数并不代表347项独立发现. 已完成的全职业比较使用团队背景+角色任务. 使用 Team 上下文 + Qualification 和所有三个科进行的额外比较超过了上下文限制,仍然未运行.

blocks.en: The following examples explain how the selected clusters differ in Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We also examine repeated recruitment and differences in description detail because these can affect the embedding distributions. MMD ranks the observed differences without establishing their statistical significance.

blocks.en: Figure 25: A grouped bar chart that compares how many comparisons use all advertisements in the selected groups for each occupation, where blue represents comparisons across months and pink represents comparisons between different clusters within one month. For Data Analyst advertisements, we complete 17 monthly and 16 same-month comparisons, followed by 16 and 14 for Data Scientist advertisements. blocks.en: C.2 Monthly Differences Within the Same Cluster
blocks.zh: C.2 同一组内的每月差额

blocks.en: Figure 26: A PCA scatter plot and two histograms comparing Data Scientist all-sections cluster 0 in February and September 2026. Blue represents February and pink represents September, and the plots use the same PCA components. The February and September advertisements overlap in the scatter plot, but their histograms show different concentrations. September has more density near − 0.2 -0.2 on both axes, whereas February is more concentrated near zero on PC 1 and above zero on PC 2. We therefore see changes in the distribution within the same Data Scientist cluster without a complete separation of the points. MMD is 0.0707 across all original embedding dimensions, and the first and second PCA components explain 6.8% and 5.1% of the variance in the job-ad vectors used to fit PCA.
blocks.zh: 图26:2026年2月和9月,一个PCA散射图和两个直方图比较了数据科学家全块组0。 蓝色代表2月,粉红色代表9月,地块使用相同的PCA组件. 2月和9月的广告在散块情节中重叠,但其直方图显示的浓度不同. 9月的密度在两轴上接近−0.2-0.2,而2月更集中在PC1上接近0,而PC2上则高于0. 因此,我们看到同一数据科学家组内分布的变化,没有将各点完全分开。 MMD在所有原始嵌入维度中为0.0707,其中第一和第二个PCA组件解释了用于适应PCA的职称矢量差异的6.8%和5.1%.

blocks.en: Figure 27: A pair of line charts that tracks the share of advertisements in a selected Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer cluster across two months. Counts appear beside the points, and MMD measures differences between the all-sections embedding distributions. The Data Scientist line stays almost flat at 14.7% in February and 14.5% in September even as the number of advertisements falls from 43 to 32. Its MMD of 0.071 records a difference in description vectors that the nearly unchanged share does not express. The Machine Learning Engineer line rises from 71.1% to 77.8% between November and December alongside MMD 0.191. The Data Scientist and Machine Learning Engineer comparisons shown in the two panels distinguish changes in a cluster’s share of advertisements from changes in the descriptions within that cluster.
blocks.zh: 图27:一对跟踪广告在选定的数据科学家或机器学习工程师集群中份额的行图,历时两个月. 计数出现在点旁边,MMD测量所有部分嵌入分布之间的差异. 尽管广告数量从43个下降到32个,但数据科学家的线路在2月和9月几乎保持平稳,分别为14.7%和14.5%。 其0.071的MMD记录了描述矢量的区别,几乎不变的份额并不表示. 机器学习工程师线路在11月至12月期间与MMD 0.191同时从71.1%上升到77.8%. 这两个小组中显示的数据科学家和机器学习工程师的比较将一个集群广告份额的变化与该集群内描述的变化区分开来。

blocks.en: For Data Scientist advertisements with all three sections, cluster 0 contains 43 postings from 27 company names in February 2026 and 32 postings from 29 company names in September. Its share of the available Data Scientist advertisements stays close to the same level, at 14.7% and 14.5%, although MMD is 0.0707. As shown in Figures 26 and 27 , the descriptions can differ even when the cluster contains a similar share of the occupation’s advertisements.

blocks.en: C.3 Data Scientist Clusters Differ in Their Use of Machine Learning Models
blocks.zh: C.3 数据科学家 使用机器学习模型的集群差异

blocks.en: For February 2026, Data Scientist Team context clusters 2 and 3 contain 64 and 39 advertisements from 17 and 13 company names respectively, with MMD 0.4155. Cluster 2 describes engineering, business and research applications, and cluster 3 places greater emphasis on healthcare and life-science work.
blocks.zh: 2026年2月,数据科学家 团队背景 第2组和第3组分别载有来自17个和13个公司名称的64个和39个广告,MMD 0.4155. 第2组描述工程,商业和研究的应用,第3组更加重视保健和生命科学工作.

blocks.en: For example, Impinj’s advertisement in cluster 2 describes algorithms for product quality and manufacturing yield, whereas AbbVie’s advertisement in cluster 3 describes annotating sequencing variants to study their functional effects in disease ( 4361074947 , 4290822999 ). blocks.en: D.1 What We Learned from the SAE Pilots
blocks.zh: D.1 我们从SAE飞行员那里学到了什么

blocks.en: Before the final comparison, we tested GPT-2 and Gemma language models, trained SAEs on sentence embeddings and examined changes in feature labeling, pooling, sparsity and domain interpretation. These experiments led us to check description format and verify proposed characteristics in held-out advertisements. We report them separately because they use different samples, definitions and selection criteria from the comparison of PERC, SAE and text-only inputs.
blocks.zh: 在最终比较之前,我们测试了GPT-2和Gemma语言模型,对SAEs进行了关于句子嵌入的培训,并检查了特征标签,集合,痉挛度和域解释的变化. 这些实验使我们检查了描述格式,并验证了搁置广告中的拟议特征. 我们单独报告,因为它们使用不同的样本、定义和选择标准,与比较PERC、SAE和仅文本输入相比。

blocks.en: In the section-embedding pilot, we compare Top-k SAEs with dictionaries of 512 or 1,024 features, eight or sixteen active features and five seeds. The selected 1,024-feature configuration with k = 8 k=8 has 79 stable features, of which 77 activate in at least 20 advertisements. A separate embedding-model pilot obtains 96 stable features with the same dictionary size and k = 8 k=8 , including 88 that activate in at least 20 advertisements. These counts describe features that can be aligned across runs, so they do not by themselves establish meaningful occupational characteristics. In the higher-capacity experiment, a 1,024-feature dictionary with k = 32 k=32 gives 11 stable features and k = 64 k=64 gives none under that experiment’s feature-matching criteria.
blocks.zh: 在分块嵌入式飞行员中,我们比较Top-k SAE与512或1,024个特征的词典,8或16个活跃特征和5个种子. 所选的1,024-feature配置的k=8k=8有79个稳定特征,其中77个在至少20个广告中激活. 一个单独的嵌入模型飞行员获得96个稳定特征,词典大小相同,k=8k=8,包括88个在至少20个广告中激活. 这些计数描述了可以相互配合的特征,因此它们本身并不建立有意义的职业特征。 在功率较高的实验中,使用k=32k=32的1 024字典给出了11个稳定特征,K=64k=64给出了该实验的特征比对标准下的无.

blocks.en: Independent checks find some useful labels. Five of eight labels pass the work-domain confirmation criteria, including “sports,” “transportation,” “manufacturing analytics,” “healthcare” and “pricing.” A separate confirmation finds five of eight passing labels for “sustainability,” “continuous improvement,” “financial close,” “data governance” and “recruiting.” These results describe the selected features and advertisements, and the artifact catalog also records the unsuccessful and incomplete runs. They do not establish that the trained SAE performs better than the final pretrained SAE or PERC.
blocks.zh: 独立检查找到一些有用的标签. 8个标签中有5个通过了工作领域确认标准,包括“体育”、“运输”、“制造分析”、“保健”和“定价”。 另有一份确认书发现,在“可持续性”、“持续改进”、“财务结算”、“数据治理”和“征聘”的8个标签中,有5个标注。 这些结果描述了选定的特征和广告,而文物目录也记录了不成功和不完整的运行情况。 他们没有确定受过训练的高级中学毕业证书的表现优于最后经过训练的高级中学毕业证书或高级中学毕业证书。

blocks.en: The complete Gemma experiment contains 126,759 observations across Role task, Team context, Qualifications and original descriptions, representing all 36,081 prepared advertisements. Its eight-cluster fits have reduced-space cosine silhouettes of 0.130, 0.139, 0.175 and 0.224 for those inputs respectively, and mean ARIs across initializations of 0.629, 0.905, 0.946 and 0.915. Because these silhouettes use the reduced representation, they cannot be ranked directly against PERC’s original-vector silhouettes. The posting-period comparison in the main text also shows that greater separation can reflect description format and length rather than more distinct kinds of work.

blocks.en: D.2 Which Hypotheses Enter Each Statistical Comparison
blocks.zh: D.2 假设输入每个统计比较

blocks.en: The original Llama analysis contains 110 hypotheses from 15 paired comparisons. The comparison with PERC retains separate sets of tests for the original paired-advertisement study and the expanded monthly study. The expanded monthly set contains 1,867 tests, including 1,271 checks of earlier definitions, so it contains more tests than newly generated monthly hypotheses. Business Analyst comparisons have a separate set of 176 hypotheses, and Software Engineer comparisons have a separate set of 246 hypotheses, comprising 77 occupational and 169 monthly claims.
blocks.zh: 最初的Llama分析包含来自15对比的110个假设. 与PERC的比较保留了对原配对广告研究和扩大的月度研究的单独一组测试. 扩充后的月度套装包含1,867项测试,其中包括对先前定义的1,271项检查,因此包含比新生成的月度假设更多的测试. 业务分析师比较有一套单独的176个假设,软件工程师比较有一套单独的246个假设,包括77个职业索赔和169个月索赔。

blocks.en: The combined results contain 1,171 hypotheses generated by GPT-6 Luna across 127 comparisons. We retain the original statistical corrections for each set rather than recomputing a correction across all recorded experiments, and reused advertisements do not count as independent replications.
blocks.zh: 综合结果包含GPT-6 Luna在127个比较中产生的1,171个假设. 我们保留每集的原始统计更正,而不是对所有记录的实验进行重新计算,再利用的广告不算独立复制。

blocks.en: A feature label describes a pattern in activating text, a hypothesis is GPT-6 Luna’s claim about how a characteristic differs between occupations or months, and a verification judgment records whether GPT-6.1 Terra finds that characteristic in an advertisement. Several features can contribute to one hypothesis, and GPT-6 Luna can generate similar claims from PERC clusters, SAE features or text alone. We therefore distinguish feature activation, verified characteristics and cluster measurements throughout the results. Feature IDs are specific to each SAE checkpoint, so an ID in Gemma does not represent the same feature as that ID in Llama.
blocks.zh: 一个特征标签描述了激活文本中的模式,一个假说是GPT-6 Luna关于一种特征在职业或月份之间如何不同的说法,一个验证判断记录了GPT-6.1 Terra是否在广告中发现了这一特征. 有几个特征可以促进一种假说,GPT-6 Luna可以单独从PERC集群,SAE特征或文本中产生类似的主张. 因此,我们在整个结果中区分特征激活、核实特征和集群测量。 每个SAE检查站都有特色标识,因此Gemma的标识并不代表与Llama的标识相同的特征.

blocks.en: Appendix E Additional Method Details and Feature Maps

blocks.en: E.1 Selecting Advertisements and Checking Hypotheses
blocks.zh: E.1 选择广告和检查假象

blocks.en: To compare what PERC clusters, SAE features and text alone add to hypothesis generation, we give GPT-6 Luna the same selected job-ad sections under all three conditions. We use LinkedIn advertisements collected within seven days of posting and pair advertisements from different occupations within the same 2026 posting month, matching the formatting of their descriptions. Each pair must have a section character-length ratio no greater than 1.25. We first select the largest possible set of eligible pairs and then minimize their differences in log character length, allowing at most one advertisement per company in each comparison group. Before verification, we remove test-company sections or full descriptions that duplicate the text used to generate hypotheses after normalization.
blocks.zh: 为了比较PERC集群,SAE的特征和文本本身为假说生成增加了哪些内容,我们在所有三个条件下给GPT-6 Luna提供了相同的选定的待职部分. 我们使用LinkedIn在2026年同一月发布后七天内收集的广告和来自不同职业的配对广告,与其描述的格式相匹配。 每对必须有一个不超过1.25的节字符长比. 我们首先选择尽可能多的一组合格配对,然后尽量减少它们在对数字符长度上的差别,在每个比较组中最多允许每个公司发布一次广告. 在核查之前,我们删除测试公司部分或完整描述,这些部分或完整描述重复了正常化后用来产生假设的文字.

blocks.en: For the PERC condition, we refit the selected configuration on the descriptions used to generate hypotheses. In the Business Analyst and Software Engineer comparisons, we pool these descriptions by section when an individual sample cannot support the selected dimensionality reduction. We do not apply the 30-advertisement threshold used when Terra compares all descriptions in selected groups here because this experiment gives the same selected sections to all three conditions.
blocks.zh: 对于 PERC 条件,我们对用于生成假说描述的选定配置进行重置. 在业务分析员和软件工程师的比较中,当单个样本无法支持选定的维度减少时,我们按科级汇总这些说明。 我们不应用在Terra比较所选组中所有描述时使用的30个广告阈值,因为这个实验给所有三个条件都提供了相同的选定部分.

blocks.en: After GPT-6 Luna generates the claims, GPT-6.1 Terra receives the complete held-out sections, anonymous text identifiers and the unchanged hypothesis definitions. We omit separate occupation, company, month, method and activation information, although employer details can remain in the descriptions themselves. To mark a characteristic as present, GPT-6.1 Terra must provide an exact quotation from the advertisement. We include unclear judgments in the total number of advertisements checked and repeat the calculation with unclear judgments counted as present to examine their effect on the result.
blocks.zh: 在GPT-6 Luna生成索赔后,GPT-6.1 Terra收到完整的搁置部分,匿名文本标识符和不变的假说定义. 我们省略了单独的职业、公司、月数、方法和激活信息,尽管雇主的细节可以保留在描述中。 为了标出目前的特点,GPT-6.1 Terra必须提供广告的确切引文。 我们列入经检查的广告总数中不明确的判断,并重复计算,并计入目前不清楚的判断,以审查其对结果的影响。

blocks.en: To calculate confidence intervals, we resample companies connected through the selected advertisement pairs together, keeping repeated links between companies in the same resampling unit. We also use a sign-flip test that swaps the two group labels within each connected component. We count a difference as statistically supported when its adjusted p-value is at most 0.05, its absolute frequency difference exceeds 0.01 and its direction agrees with GPT-6 Luna’s claim. We calculate adjusted p-values using both Benjamini–Hochberg (BH) and Benjamini–Yekutieli (BY) correction. The test assumes that swapping the two group labels within each connected component is valid under the null hypothesis, and the observational comparisons do not establish a causal change in hiring.
blocks.zh: 为了计算置信间隔,我们将通过选定的广告对连接起来的公司重新进行采样,使同一复制单元的公司之间保持重复的联系. 我们还使用一个标志-flip测试,在每个连接组件中互换两个组标签. 当调整后的p值最多为0.05时,它的绝对频率差超过0.01,而且它的方向同意GPT-6 Luna的主张时,我们算作统计支持的差值。 我们使用Benjamini-Hochberg(BH)和Benjamini-Yekutieli(BY)的校正计算调整的p值。 测试假设在每个连接组件内互换两个组的标签,在无效假说下是有效的,观察比较并不能确定聘用的因果变化.

blocks.en: We apply these corrections separately to the Data Scientist–Data Analyst and Machine Learning Engineer–Data Scientist study, the expanded monthly study, the Business Analyst study and the Software Engineer study. The expanded monthly set contains 1,867 tests, including checks of previously generated definitions. No monthly or Business Analyst hypothesis passes either correction. We also keep the occupational results from the Data Scientist and Software Engineer comparisons separate in the main tables because they belong to different sets of tests.
blocks.zh: 我们将这些更正分别应用于数据科学家-数据分析师和机器学习工程师-数据科学家研究、扩大月度研究、商业分析师研究和软件工程师研究。 扩充后的月度套装包含1,867项测试,包括检查以前产生的定义. 没有月度或业务分析员假说通过修正。 我们还在主要表格中保留数据科学家和软件工程师比较的职业结果,因为这些结果属于不同的成套测试。

blocks.en: The recorded API cost of feature labeling and hypothesis generation is $17.50 with SAE inputs, $0.28 with PERC inputs and $0.31 with text alone across 86 Data Scientist, Data Analyst and Machine Learning Engineer comparisons. The corresponding costs are $3.64, $0.042 and $0.041 for Business Analyst comparisons, and $5.231, $0.080 and $0.092 for Software Engineer comparisons. These amounts exclude inference with the language model used to extract SAE features, cached embeddings and shared verification. Although we allow the same maximum generation budget for each condition, the actual spending differs.
blocks.zh: 所记录的特性标签和假说生成的API成本为17.50美元,其中SAE投入为0.28美元,PERC投入为0.31美元,仅文字成本为86个数据科学家、数据分析员和机器学习工程师的比较。 相应的费用为:业务分析员比较3.64美元、0.042美元和0.041美元;软件工程师比较5.231美元、0.080美元和0.092美元。 这些金额排除了对用于提取SAE特性,缓存嵌入和共享验证的语言模型的推论. 尽管我们允许每个条件的相同的最高生成预算,但实际支出却不同。

blocks.en: E.3 SAE Extraction and Feature Clustering
blocks.zh: E.3 SAE 提取和地物组合

blocks.en: To extract features, we run Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct in bfloat16 without quantization and the Goodfire SAE in float32. At layer 19, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct produces a 4,096-dimensional residual state for each token. The SAE’s linear encoder and ReLU transform this state into 65,536 feature activations, and its linear decoder reconstructs the residual state. We compare the converted SAE weights with the downloaded checkpoint and check the extracted residuals against a complete forward pass through Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
blocks.zh: 为了提取特征,我们在bfloat16中运行Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct,不进行量化,在float32中运行Goodfire SAE. 在第19层,Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct为每个令牌产生4,096维的残留状态. SAE的线性编码器和ReLU将这个状态转化为65,536个特性激活,其线性解码器重建了剩余状态. 我们比较已转换的SAE加权数和下载的检查站,并对照Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct的完整前进通道检查提取的残余物。

blocks.en: We count a feature as present when at least two source tokens have positive activation, excluding beginning-of-sequence and padding tokens. We also repeat the presence calculation using one token as a sensitivity check. When labeling a feature, GPT-6 Luna reads up to ten sections where it activates and ten sections where no tokens activate it. Sections with only one activating token do not count as inactive examples. GPT-6 Luna then combines related labels into at most ten hypotheses per comparison, with at least two supporting source descriptions per hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 我们把一个特征算作是存在的,当至少两个源符号有正激活时,不包括开始序列和补注符号. 我们还重复使用一个符号进行存在计算作为灵敏度检查. 在给一个特性贴标签时,GPT-6 Luna可读到最多十节,其中它可以激活,而十节则没有符号可以激活. 只有一个激活符的段落不计为非活动示例 。 GPT-6 Luna随后将相关标签合并为每次比较最多10个假设,每个假设至少有两个支持源描述.

blocks.en: To examine how features relate to one another, we combine unique job-ad sections used for hypothesis generation across the Data Scientist, Data Analyst, Machine Learning Engineer, Business Analyst and Software Engineer comparisons. We weight each binary activation by inverse feature frequency, normalize each advertisement’s activation vector and fit truncated singular-value decomposition (SVD) with 50 components. Each feature is represented by its SVD loading scaled by the singular values and then normalized. We retain features that activate in 1% to 99% of the section sample, so the map compares features observed across multiple advertisements without including those active almost everywhere.
blocks.zh: 为了审查各种特征如何相互关联,我们合并了数据科学家、数据分析员、机器学习工程师、业务分析员和软件工程师等用于假设生成的独特的工作部门。 我们通过反向特性频率对每个二元激活进行加权,使每个广告的激活矢量正常化,并配有50个组件的短切单值分解(SVD). 每个特性由它的SVD加载以单数缩放,然后正常化来表示. 我们保留了1%到99%的片段样本中激活的特性,因此地图比较了多个广告中观察到的特性,而没有包括几乎遍及各地的活跃特性.

blocks.en: We apply K-means to the 50-dimensional feature vectors and compare four, six, eight, ten and twelve clusters. For each section, we calculate cosine silhouette on the same sample of 2,000 features and select the cluster count with the highest score. This gives twelve clusters for Team context, eight for Role task and ten for Qualifications, with sampled silhouettes of 0.071, 0.097 and 0.123 respectively. ARI between two initializations is 0.669, 0.863 and 0.816 for those sections. We then use PCA to display the features in two dimensions, keeping their coordinates unchanged across the selected PERC comparisons.
blocks.zh: 我们对50维特性矢量应用K-意思,比较四,六,八,十和十二组. 对于每一节,我们用2,000个特性的相同样本计算出余弦硅声,并选择得分最高的组数. 这使小组的背景分为12组,角色任务分为8组,资格分为10组,抽样的Silhouette分别为0.071、0.097和0.123。 两个初始化之间的ARI为0.669,0.863和0.816。 然后,我们使用五氯苯甲醚在两个维度上显示特征,在选定的PERC比较中保持坐标不变。

blocks.en: Figure 29: A series of PCA scatter plots of SAE features, where each point represents one feature and each color represents a K-means cluster. The descriptions below each plot represent the patterns found among labeled features in each cluster. Role task and Qualifications show broad colored regions, whereas Team context has more colors mixed near its center. In Role task, the blue region on the right includes features related to “applied analytics,” “developing machine learning models” and “collaboration”, and the gold region below includes “Operations, business metrics and reporting”. In Qualifications, the right-hand blue region includes “Technical competencies, tools and skill lists” and the lower green region includes “Student status, graduation timing and eligibility”. Other clusters contain grammar and recruiting language, showing that SAE features group writing patterns alongside work content.
blocks.zh: 图29:一系列五氯苯甲醚撒布的SAE特征图案,其中每个点代表一个特征,每个颜色代表一个K-分子群. 每个图案下面的描述代表着每个集群中标签特征中发现的图案. 角色任务和资格表显示的是广泛的彩色区域,而团队背景则在其中心附近有较多的彩色混合. 在角色任务中,右边的蓝色区域包括与“应用分析”、“开发机器学习模型”和“协作”有关的特征,下面的黄金区域包括“业务、商业指标和报告”。 在资格方面,右手蓝色区域包括“技术能力、工具和技能清单”,绿色区域则包括“学生地位、毕业时间和资格”。 其他集群包含语法和招聘语言,显示SAE将组写模式与工作内容并列.

blocks.en: GPT-6 Luna has labeled 10,581 of the 45,006 features represented in the section maps through the preceding occupation and monthly comparisons. Features appearing in more than one job-description section are counted separately for each section. To describe each feature cluster, we inspect labels near its center and their source quotations. Because these labels were selected for specific comparisons, their coverage varies across feature clusters. Some clusters contain grammatical or recruiting patterns, and we leave clusters with too few informative labels uninterpreted.
blocks.zh: GPT-6 Luna通过前一个职业和月度比较,将部分地图中代表的45,006个特征中的10,581个标注了标签. 在一个以上职务说明部分出现的特征,每个部分分别计算. 为了描述每个特性集群,我们检查其中心附近的标签及其源引文. 因为这些标签被选作具体比较,其覆盖范围因特征集群而异. 一些集群包含语法模式或招聘模式,我们留下的集群信息性标签太少而不解释.

blocks.en: For the analysis within selected PERC clusters, we retain the membership of three completed MMD comparisons: Data Scientist Team context clusters 2 and 3 in February 2026 with 64 and 39 advertisements, Business Analyst Role task cluster 0 in April and September 2026 with 82 and 40 advertisements, and Data Scientist Qualifications clusters 0 and 2 in December 2025 with 278 and 118 advertisements. We extract each advertisement’s complete selected section and reuse the activations when its text is identical to a section already processed. Repeated descriptions still count as separate postings in the activation percentages. We use the existing feature clusters to describe these PERC comparisons without fitting new groups or generating new claims about the wider job market.
blocks.zh: 为了在选定的PERC组内进行分析,我们保留三个已完成的MMD比较的成员: 数据科学家 团队背景 第2组和第3组于2026年2月发布64和39条广告,业务分析员角色任务 第0组于2026年4月和9月发布82和40条广告,数据科学家资格第0和2组于2025年12月发布278和118条广告. 我们提取每个广告的完整部分, 重复描述在激活百分比中仍算作单独的张贴。 我们利用现有的特征集群来描述这些PERC比较,而无需适应新的群体或对更广泛的就业市场提出新的诉求。

blocks.en: The health-sector feature shown in Figure 12 received different labels across earlier comparisons, including unclear wording and “operational analytics.” Its activation difference shows that the representation responds differently to the two PERC samples, although this feature has not been validated as a healthcare classifier.
blocks.zh: 图12所示的卫生部门特征在先前的比较中得到了不同的标签,包括措辞不明确和“业务分析”。 它的激活差表明,该代表物对两个PERC样本的反应不同,尽管这个特征还没有被验证为保健分类器.

blocks.en: Together, the three comparisons contain 621 job-description sections across the selected postings, containing 354 distinct texts. Each section matches the text used in its PERC comparison and is processed without truncation. We run Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct once per distinct text and then count repeated descriptions at the posting level when calculating activation rates.
blocks.zh: 这三个比较共包含621个职位说明部分,包括354个不同的文本。 每一节都与其PERC比较中使用的文本相匹配,并不加截断处理. 我们运行Llama-3.1-8B-Instructiont一次每个单独的文本,然后在计算激活率时计算张贴级别的重复描述.
